tei:div.tei:p: "$ (311)༄༅// zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum gyi khrid yig rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(312)༄༅// oṃ sid+dhi rastu/ rgyal ba sku bzhi'i ma dros mtsho chen las// bka' babs rnam bzhi'i rgyun du skal ldan gyi// gdung sel mdzad po bla ma la btud nas// sdug bsngal zhi byed bdud rtsi'i nying khu bri// 'di ltar 'khor ba nyid snang dus nyid nas yang dag tu ma grub pas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin kyang*/ phyin ci log gi rtog pa'i rkyen las sdug bsngal gyis 'khor mor mnar bas nyam thag par gyur pa ste/ de las rnam par grol bar bya ba'i phyir/ dam pa'i chos nyams su len dgos la/ de yang gang zag gi blo'i rim pa la dgongs nas sangs rgyas kyis theg pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pa las/ da res kyi chos 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa'i zhal nas/ 'gro ba sdug bsngal gdungs pa la// zhi byed bsil ldan dri med bshad// ces pa ltar dam pa'i chos spyi'i ming bye brag la btags nas gces ming sgos su thob pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi byed bya ba de lags/ 'di la'ang dam pa rin po che bod du lan grangs mang du byon pa'i stobs kyis/ brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum la gdams pa'i man ngag gi bka' srol gsum las/ thog mar bka' babs dang po'i khrid la bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ thub dbang*/ phyag rdor/ sgrol ma/ klu sgrub/ rdzus skyes ār+ya de ba/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ (313)kha che dz+nyā na gu h+ya/ dbon po dpal ldan shes rab/ de gnyis ka las dbus pa lo ston btsun chung gis gsan/ de nas sras rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ chus pa dar ma brtson 'grus/ chus pa dar ma seng ge/ rog shes rab 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams dpal/ rgyal sras kun dga' sku mched/ rgya ston smon lam shes rab/ kun mkhyen sku mched/ rgya sgom rdo rje gdan pa/ byang sems sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ sku gsum bde chen lhun grub/ mkhas grub nam mkha' bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor lhun grub/

khyab bdag dpal 'byor phun tshogs/ kun spang bkra shis bzang po/ rje btsun blo gros brtan pa/ des bdag dharma shrī la'o// gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ dang po la bzhi/ dang po thar lam rgyud la skye ba'i go cha 'di dang 'khor ba'i zhen 'phris kyis bkag pa yin pas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las 'bras smin tshul bsam pa rnams rgyud la myong ba skyes skyes su sgom du gzhug /gnyis pa gdams ngag rgyud la 'char ba'i go las kyi sgrib pas bkag pa yin pas/ de sbyong ba'i phyir/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla la bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng rdo rje 'dzin pa tshangs par spyod pa'i chas can rdo rje skyil krung (314)gis bzhugs pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gzhan sems can gyi las sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsam nas kaṃ ka ni'i bzlas pa ci nus byas mthar lha rang la bstim mo// gsum pa nyams dang rtogs pa 'char ba'i go dam tshig nyams chags kyis bkag pa yin pas de sbyang ba'i phyir spyi bor pad zla la bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ yag dkar po// de las bdud rtsi dkar ba'i rgyun zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong las babs pa tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kyi phyi nang thams cad na mar sham sham song bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad gshang gci'i lam dang rkang sen nas nyil nyil sbyangs pas mthar lus nang shel sgong phyis pa ltar dag par bsam la/ yig brgya ci nus bzlas rjes spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bstim mo// bzhi pa nges shes dang byin rlabs 'jug pa'i go bla ma la tshad mar ma bzung bas bkag pa yin pas/

skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs bya ste/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma kun 'dus rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ de'i spyi bor 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge /de gnyis ka'i mtha' bskor du ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro nam mkha' gang bar bsam la/ re ltos lings skyur gyi mos gus drag pos/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bla ma rin po che mkhyen/ bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa bskyed du gsol/ zhen 'khris med pa'i phan sems dang snying rje chen po rgyud la skye bar (315)mdzad du gsol/ dag pa'i snang ba sna tshogs 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes ci nus dang*/ spro na/ na mo gu ru/ gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri bo ru/ zhes sogs brgyud 'debs kyang 'don zhing*/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas de rnams las ye shes kyi 'od zer dkar po byung ba rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag /bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ mthar rten rnams tshad med pa'i thugs rjes 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas mar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rje btsun dam pas grub thob lnga bcu rtsa lnga'i gdams pa rnams gnad lngar bsdus nas gsungs pa ste/ des na 'di na dpe lngas mtshon pa'i don gyi gdams pa lnga las/ dang po mtshan nyid sgra dang rig pa'i brgyud pa bcu gnyis klu sgrub la brgyud de nam mkha' lta bu'i gdams ngag la 'dus pas/ 'di la bzhi ste/ kun rdzob la slob pa/ don dam la slob pa/ zung 'jug la slob pa/ de yang rab tu mi gnas pa'o// dang po ni/ las dang po pas phyi nang gi snang ba la zhen pa ldog pa'i phyir bsgom pa ste/ dben pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la rkang pa rdor skyil dang lag pa mnyam gzhag sogs chos bdun ldan gyis lus gnad bcas la phyi nang du snang ba'i dngos po 'di dag snang ba ltar bden bden 'dra ba 'dug kyang*/

rang sems kyi 'khrul snang du shar ba las/ don la cung zad kyang grub pa med pas/ rmi lam dang 'dra zhes 'dun pa yang yang sbyangs/ de ltar bsgom pas nyams myong ni/ snang ba la bden zhen gyi blo log ste/ gzugs snang tshad chu zla lta bu/ sgra grag tshad brag cha lta bu/ dri tshor tshad dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ ro myong tshad sgyu ma'i kha zas lta bu/ reg myong tshad rmi lam gyi sgeg mo dang 'grogs pa lta bu'i (316)nyams 'char ro// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar snang ba la zhen pa log nas don dam skye med la 'dris par bya ba'i phyir sgom pa ste/ lus gnad sngar ltar las/ rang sems kyi ngo bo la cher gyis bltas shing btsal ba na/ dbyibs kha dog sogs ngo bo gang du yang ma grub pas skye med du thag bcad nas/ gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i rig pa spros med 'od gsal gyi ngang du lhan gyis bzhag go /de ltar bzhag can/ rnam rtog gi 'gyu ba chad nas/ rig pa gsal dwangs mi g.yo bar gnas te/ mun khung du'ang snang ba 'char ba dang*/ lus kyi rtsa rnams mthong ba dang*/ rig pa gang la'ang thogs pa med pa 'byung zhing bying rgod med par ye re sing nge gnas mas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rang lugs su skye'o// gsum pa ni/ rig pa la bzla ba'i phyir sgom pa ste/ snang ba'i chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur snang tsam nyid na rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu dang don dam spros bral gnyis so so tha mi dad par zung 'jug tu thag bcad de sgom mo// bzhi pa ni/ zung 'jug de ka'i rang ngo la bltas pas gtad med du yal nas ci yang ma mthong ba'i blo ba bya byed/ yid kyi 'gro 'ong chad nas khas len thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la so mar 'jog pa ste/ dbu ma rab tu mi gnas pa'o// gnyis pa pha rgyud byin rlabs rlung gi brgyud pa bcu gcig bud+dha dz+nyā na nas brgyud de rdo rje lta bu'i gdams ngag tu 'dus pas/

'di la bzhi ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis rlung bzung ba/ rdo rje'i bzlas pas rlung bzung ba/ sems la gtad pas rlung bzung ba/ de yang 'od gsal dri ma med pa'o// dang po ni/ stan bde ba la rkang pa rdor skyil/ sgal tshig drang por bsrangs/ lag gnyis gnya' gong du bzhag la sog pa sna sprad/ thong ka sgyed cing mgo bkug la mnan/ mig sna rtser phab la nywa bzhi (317)sgrims pas rlung rang shugs la zin pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang lus rdo rje rtse gsum pa sbubs stong du sgom pa'i lte bar rig pa hūm̐ yig yungs 'bru tsam gcig gsal btab rlung bum pa can dang sbyar te rlung phyir 'phang ba'i tshe hūm̐ yig de rdo rje mas sna'i lam nas mar song bas rlung gi dug dbyung*/ rlung nang du rngubs pa'i tshe rlung de tshangs pa'i bu ga nas yar song bas ye shes kyi mthong phye ba'o// gsum pa ni/ rlung nang du gnas pa'i tshe hūm̐ yig lte bar gnas pa la sems gtad de bde lhan ne'i ngang la rig pa skye med du seng nge hrig ge gtad de sgom mo// bzhi pa ni/ de ltar yun je ring du goms pas rlung zin pa'i rtags su/ sa rlung zin pas mig sgyu lta bu/ chu rlung zin pas du ba lta bu/ rlung gi rlung zin pas mar me lta bu/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pas sprin dang mkha' snang lta bu 'byung ste/ 'od gsal dri ma med pa'i snang ba'o// gsum pa ma rgyud bde ba nyams kyi brgyud pa bcu gcig mtsho skyes nas brgyud de pad+ma lta bu'i gdams ngag tu 'dus pas/ 'di la bzhi ste/ 'og gi bde ba sbar ba/ steng gi bde ba 'dzag pa/ bskyil bzlog dgram gsum gyi man ngag /de la skyon gyis ma gos pa'o// dang po ni/ stan bde ba la rkang pa pad skyil bca'/ sgal tshig bsrang ste sked pa mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis bsgoms la sor mo brgyad kyis lte ba'i 'og tu btsir/ rang nyid gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa gsum bsgoms pa'i dbu ma'i mas snar a shad dmar po me'i rang bzhin/

de nas steng rlung mnan rtsa bzhi sgrims la 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyis bde ba nang du rngub/ des tsaṇ+ḍa lī 'bar bas rlung me'i drod can a ba dhū ti nas yar zhugs nas lus bde drod du 'bar ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ dngos rig gam yid rig gang rung yum rnal 'byor ma (318)sgom pa'i thabs shes kyi mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+mar byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms par zhugs nas/ gtum mo 'bar ba'i drod kyis dbu ma'i yas sna na haṃ yig bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gnas pa zhu ba'i byang sems kyi rgyun 'dzag pas bde ba'i nyams skyes pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bskyil ba'i thabs la mkhas pa ba mo'i nu ma lta bu ste/ lus kyi ka ra ṇa bcing ba zhes mig gyen la ldog /steng rlung bsal te lto ba tshigs pa la sbyar/ yan lag bzhi bskum/ lce dril/ 'og rlung drag tu glang cing*/ dbu ma'i spyan la sems bzung ngo*// de nas ldog pa'i thabs la mkhas pa lcags sbubs kyis chu 'dren pa lta bu ni/ dpyangs thag khongs 'dren gyi rlung gnad dang 'gyur bzhis drang ngos/ dgram pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dpag bsam gyi shing rgyas pa lta bu ni/ seng ge rnam rol gyis khyab par dgram mo// mthar bstim pa'i thabs la mkhas pa mkha' la sprin dengs pa lta bu ni/ bum pa can 'ga' zhig sgom zhing rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag pas rlung gi yon tan sems la bstim pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ de lta bu'i thabs kyis zin na dngos rig bsten kyang 'khor ba'i skyon gyis mi gos te/ pad+ma 'dam na gnas kyang de'i skyon gyis mi gos pa bzhin no// bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po brda'i brgyud pa bcu gcig pa sa ra ha nas brgyud de bdud rtsi lta bu'i gdams ngag tu 'dus pas 'di la bzhi ste/ brda dbang bskur ba/ brda ngo sprod pa/ brda lam du khyer ba/ ma skyes pa'i 'grang gtam tshig gcig go /dang po ni/ sa phyogs dben par slob ma rnams mdun du bzhag nas/

maṇ+ḍal sngon 'gros lus gnad bsrangs te/ lta stangs mi 'gyur bas rlung dang shes pa so mar glod du bcug la/ bla mas ting nge 'dzin gyi ngar dang ldan (319)bas/ rtsa ba'i spyod lam bzhi la yan lag lnga lnga phyi ba'i brda nyi shu bsgyur te rdor skyil/ phyed skyil/ tsog pu/ mnye thabs/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs te 'dug pa lnga/ g.yas nyal/ g.yon nyal/ gan rkyal/ kha sbubs/ mgo bstums te nyal ba lnga/ langs ka /phyed langs/ langs pa/ gos gyon pa/ las ka byed pa ste 'chags pa lnga/ 'gro ba/ 'gro 'phro la 'chams pa/ rgyug pa/ rgyug 'phro la 'chams pa/ ngal bso gsob ste 'gro ba lnga/ de ltar nyi shu bsgyur bas skal ldan rnams la ye shes phebs pa dang shes rab zin pa 'ong ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ 'dug pa'i brda lnga mnyam bzhag la ngo sprad de/ de la phyir bcud pa ni/ sgo lnga'i yul du gang shar la che re bltas te dus gsum gyi shes pa bcad nas shes pa skad cig ma dwang sang nge ba'i ngang la bzhag go /nang du bcud pa ni/ rnam rtog phra rags ci skyes de ka hril gyis sgrims la yer gyis bzung nas hrig ge rjen ne ba'i ngang la dwang sang nge so mar bzhag go /sor bzhag pa ni/ rig pa cung zad dubs pa dang*/ lus glod/ dbugs 'don shes pa lhod de shigs se gzung 'dzin dang bral bar bzhag go /de ltar mnyam gzhag gsum nyams su blangs pas bogs chung na/ lus bsgul ba dang*/ ngag hūm̐ dang phaṭa brjod pa'i lcag gnyis gdab ste gsal brdo ba la bshig pas yul rang stong dang*/ sems nyid rig stong du shar nas stong gsal bde ba'i nyams 'char ro// nyal ba'i brda lnga bsam gtan gnyid dang bsre ba ste/ mtshan mo rmi lam du slong ba'i 'dun pas a yig la sems gtad de nyal bas gnyid 'od gsal dang rmi lam sgyu mar 'char ro// 'gro ba'i brda lnga rjes thob dang de yang 'chag pa'i brda lngas ro snyoms la ngo sprad de/ 'di la gsum las/ snying (320)po blos ma reg pa'i brda ni/

mnyam bzhag gi nyams de da dung blo yin pa srid pas/ de bshig nas rang sor lhan gyis bzhag nas bltas pas/ snang ba rang stong*/ shes pa rang dag /snang rig gnyis ka rang grol du song nas snyoms pa'o// don skye med kyi brda ni/ de'i dus na spang bya rtog bya dang*/ bsgrub bya ye shes gnyis ka la ma rnyed de rang bzhin skye ba med pa'o// ma yengs pa dri ma med pa'i brda ni/ nyams de las phyir ltas la skad cig kyang ma shor la/ bsgom bya'i bsgrub bya rdul tsam yang med pa'i blo bral chu bo'i gzhung lta bu rjes thob kyi gnas skabs kun tu lam du khyer ba'o// gsum pa ni/ spyod lam bzhi dang nyams mnyam rjes gnyis mi 'bral bar yul mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs dang lung ma bstan gsum ka la dbang po bcol nas nyams su len pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ bla mas phyag mdzub nam mkha' la sbrengs te/ ma yengs shig /brda yong ngo zhes byas pas/ slob ma'i shes pa ci la mi byed pa'i ngang du tsen ne gnas pa de ka phyag rgya chen po yin no// ma yengs par de ka ngos bzung la skyongs shig ces gdab bo// lnga pa mkha' 'gro'i brda dang ye shes kyi brgyud pa bcu gcig yi dam lha nas brgyud de 'khor lo lta bu'i gdams ngag tu 'dus pas/ 'di la bzhi ste/ mda' ltar bsring ba/ thog ltar dbab pa/ 'khor lo ltar bskor ba/ mar me ltar bzhag pa'o// dang po ni/ stan bde ba la rkang pa rdor skyil/ rked pa bsrangs/ mig gyen la ldog te shes pa khar 'phangs la/ rig pa mda' ltar bsrings te rgyang nge chod de rten med du bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ de las 'phro na mig thur du phab/ rig pa lte ba'i nang log tsam du seng yer gyi skye med du ngo sprad la mnyam par bzhag go /(321)gsum pa ni/ des bying na/ rig rtsal sbyong ste/ nam mkha' tsam du skor/ yungs 'bru tsam du bsdu/ yar rgyang mar rgyang 'khor lo ltar drag tu bskor ro// bzhi pa ni/

de ltar bcud pas rig thangs phyi nas so mar sing nge gnas pa mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa ltar bzhag /de yang shes pa snga sor ma shor/ phyi sor ma 'byams/ da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma dwang sing nge ba 'di nyid snying thad tsam du yer gyis gsal ngar dang bcas te bzhag pas las su rung ste/ de tsa na rtsa ba mthong ba/ dmigs pa gsal ba/ rno la 'khyug pa/ btang sar 'gro/ bzhag sar sdod/ dgos dus sleb/ gnad du tshud/ bkol du btub/ rig pa la byan tshud/ sems la dbang thob ste mchog tu gyur pa'i ye shes grub nas/ de las sku bzhi'i ye shes lnga lhun gyis grub bo gsung*/ gsum pa rjes la/ 'phros don bar do'i gdams pa dang*/ spyi'i spyod 'bras bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ snang ba sgyu ma'i bar do la de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ rmi lam bag chags kyi bar do la rtags 'char/ de shar nas 'chi kha sdug bsngal gyi bar do la rtsal 'byongs/ de 'byongs na srid pa 'khrul pa'i bar do la grol nges so// grol lugs ni/ gang gi mnyam bzhag gi nyams kyis nyon sgrib dag nas bden zhen gyi 'khrul pa med de/ de'i gnad kas khams gsum las 'das/ rjes thob kyi nyams kyis shes sgrib dag nas snang ba tsam gyis 'khrul pa med/ de'i gnad kas sa bcu las 'das nas chos sku skye med mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa la grogs spyod pa bstan pa dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel bar spyad par bya ste/ so thar gyi bslab bya (322)gzhan gnod bzhi bcas spang ba/ byang sdom gyi phar phyin drug dang bsdu dngos bzhis gzhan don la spyod pa/ sngags sdom gyi bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su blta zhing ma dag pa'i snang zhen thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su bsgyur ba la bslab pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ gnas skabs su rtog pa spang blang la ro snyoms/ gdon pho mo la thog brdzis/

nad 'du ba bzhi la dbang bsgyur/ mtshan rtog gis cis kyang mi gnod par ye shes skye ba'i grogs byed pa'o// mthar thug rang don du chos sku thob nas/ gzhan don du gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don 'bad med lhun grub tu byed nus pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro// zhi byed kyi khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu las/ bka' babs dang po sgrol ma gsum gyi khrid yig rtsa ba'i yig rnying ji lta ba la zhal shes kyis brgyan te bshad pa'i le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel/ ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ bka' babs bar pa la rma so kam gsum las/ dang po rma'i phyag rgya chen po snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag ces grags pa'i khrid la/ bla brgyud dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs smra seng*/ rje dam pa rgya gar/ rma sgom chos kyi shes rab/ sog po mdo sde grags/ grub thob rgyal ba te ne/ rog shes rab 'od/ zhig po nyi ma seng ge /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams dpal man chad bka' babs dang po ltar ro// gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa la sbyor dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshe 'di dang 'khor ba la blo ldog pa'i thabs kyis thar lam rgyud la skye ba'i gzhi things par byas nas/ lam gyi rmang rdo skyabs sems dang bsags sbyang gi khrid ci rigs bsgom zhing*/ khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dus/ na mo gu ru/ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du sogs gsol 'debs kyang 'don no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ (323)don gyi brgyud pa la brten nas ngo sprad pa lag khrid bcu drug dang*/ tshig gi brgyud pa la brten nas sgro 'dogs gcod byed gnad chen bcu drug go /dang po la lnga ste/ bcud kyi gdams pa bzhis rang rig pa'i ye shes ngos bzung ba/ thun gyi gdams pa bzhis srang du gzhug pa/ rtsal sbyang bzhis bogs 'don pa/ sor bzhag gnyis kyis phyag rgya chen po ngos bzung ba/

la bzla ba gnyis kyis sgom du med par gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ mtshan bcas/ mtshan med/ shin tu mtshan med/ la bzla nam mkha' lam khyer la bcud pa'o// dang po mtshan bcas la bcud pa lus ngag sems gsum las/ lus bcud la bor ba/ rkang pa rdor skyil/ lag pa mnyam bzhag /sgal tshigs bsrang*/ mgrin pa rgu/ lce yar rkan la sbyar/ mchu dang so tha mal du 'jog ste/ chos bdun bcas la sems nang du gzhug pa'o// ngag bcud la bor ba ni/ steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung 'then/ ngag gi 'gyu ba bcad pa'o// sems bcud la bor ba ni/ lus sems krim gyis sgrims la shugs 'don/ ces shes pa gzhi thog nas yer gyis bslab/ mig gi dbang po ma 'gul bar hrig ge sgrig /gang la sems 'dzin pa de la spob kyis bzhag go /de yang dmigs rten phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi ni dang po slob pa'i dus su bla ma dang slob dpon rten la bcud re bya zhing*/ lam du khyer dus dmigs rten gang rung la bcud do// nang ni snying dkar nag gi mtshams su thig le yungs 'bru tsam la dmigs pa gtad nas bcud do// de yang sems 'dzin bde ba la shigs kyis bshig la sgom blo bsam gtan gyi gnyen po zhig pas rig pa gcer bu blo bral phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod/ des so skye'i dngos zhen dang nyan rang gzung 'dzin don dam du 'dzin pa gcod do// gnyis pa mtshan med la bcud pa la'ang lus ngag sems (324)gsum las lus bcud pa ni/ nā ro'i chos bzhi ste/ gling bzhi bsdu/ rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar/ lce dar khugs su gzhug /bya rgod zung gcig nam mkha' la spar pa'o// ngag bcud pa ni/ 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung mnan/ 'gyu ba rbad kyis bcad pa'o// sems bcud pa ni/ krims kyis bsgrims/ yer gyis bslang*/ hrig gis sgrig /spob kyis bzhag /de'ang bar snang stong pa gzhu gang tsam du rig pa gtad la sems bzung*/ gsal rdo ba la shig ge nges shes bskyed cing ngo sprod/

des sems tsam pa rang rig tsam du 'dzin pa gcod do// gsum pa shin tu mtshan med la bcud pa la'ang gsum las/ lus bcud pa ni/ thab 'gal gyi 'dug stangs te/ rkang pa'i long rtsa bsnol la snying rtsa mnan/ mthe bong bkug pa'i khu tshur gnyis mchan 'og tu bcug la snying gi a so mnan/ gru mo gnyis kyis brla'i rtsa bo che gnyis mnan te/ lus thabs 'gal bcas pas rtsa sgo chen po bzhi phyi nang gnyis su gnas pa'i phyir rlung dang rtog pa'i rgyu lam gcod pa'o// ngag bcud pa ni/ 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung mnan/ sna bug g.yas nas rlung rngubs pa mchil ma'i rta la bskyon te mid 'gyu ba rbad kyis bcad do// de ni dpyangs rdo thur la skyur ba'i gnad yin no// sems bcud pa ni/ lus sems krims kyis sgrims la/ phaṭa ces rig pa gzhi thog nas yer gyis bslang*/ mig 'bras ma 'gul bar hrig ge sgrib// rig pa 'dir gtad kyi yul med par spob kyis bzhag /gsal rdo ba la bshig /nges shes bskyed cing ngo sprad/ de dbu ma pa stong pa tsam du zhen cing 'dzin pa gcod do// bzhi pa la bzla nam mkha' lam khyer la bcud pa ni/ rlung dang nyi zer gyi phyogs su kha mi blta bar lus gnad ci bder 'dug /'di gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi ngo sprod yin pas/ gzhi nam mkha' (325)la 'dus byas 'dus ma byas gnyis las 'dir 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' ste/ gzhi 'dus ma byas yin pas/ phyogs thams cad du btsal bas ma rnyed/ sems kyi gzhi rten med du song ba'o// des sems nyid ngos bzung las 'das par rtogs/ lam rig pa ni/ 'tshol mkhan gyi rig pa de nyid rtsad bcad pas/ cir yang ma grub par mthong ste/ 'di zhes bltas pas ma mthong*/ btsal bas ma rnyed de/ ngos bzung med par rtogs pa'o// 'bras bu rig pa dang nam mkha' gnyis su med pa ni/ rten med kyi rig pa de gzhi med kyi nam mkha' la phaṭa ces rgyangs kyis skyur bas/

gnyis su med pa'i nam mkha' dang 'dres te/ phye bas ma phyed phral bas ma phrol/ gzhi med kyi nam mkha' la rten ma byas pas/ rig med kyi nam mkha' la brten pa ma bcol/ gnyis med kyi nam mkha' lam du khyer bas/ chos thams cad mkha' dkyil ltar mi sgom pa'i shes pa rten med du 'char te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rang byung gi ye shes 'dus ma byas pa'o// de la sgom mi sgom med mnyam rjes med/ byas ma byas med/ bde sdug med/ dgag sgrub med/ blang dor med/ rtsal gyis bogs 'don du med/ nyams rtogs med/ thun bcud med/ sems bskyed dang kha 'thor med/ thams cad de'i nang du 'dus pas grub mtha'i ming 'dogs dang khas len thams cad med/ de tsam na chos thams cad zhig pas nyams su len ma shes/ gang zag gi bcos ma zhig /'du shes kyi dran pa gtor/ da sangs rgyas la dogs pa mi gda'/ nyams su blang rgyu ci yang mi gda'/ tha mal yengs thog tu yengs kyang thabs drag pos bcud mi dgos/ dran pa tsam gyis rtsa rnyed pa'o// 'di dang 'chi kha bar do gsum du la bzlos pas phyi mar lus mi (326)len/ da 'khor ba la dogs pa med/ sangs rgyas la re 'dod med/ gang la'ang 'dod pa med par rtogs pas/ sems bskyed dang*/ stong thun dang kha 'thor dang khar 'phog thams cad kyang rtsa ba der 'dus/ ro brgya bshal gcig gis bshal/ bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis ded/ de ltar rtsa ba gcig tu sdud shes pa ni/ pha 'dra'i bu/ rje 'dra'i 'bangs/ sa bon 'dra ba'i myu gu/ snga ma gshegs pa phyi ma'i lam yin gsung ngo*// de ltar ngo sprod pa'i tshe/ sprad bya'i gang zag 'byung lus dar ba la/ ngar 'dogs rtsal gyis gnad nas bskul te/ bcud dang rtsal sbyong drag po la gzhug /lus gud pa la gnas lugs rang so'i gnad nas bskul te/ sems bskyed la brten nas 'jam dngas kyis ngo sprad/ dran rtog rgod na dmigs pa gcig la dril te/ ngo sprod sna kha mang po spangs nas gcig la 'jun du gzhug

/dman rmongs glen blun la nges shes gcig gis bskyed de spros pa mang po mi 'chad par tshig nyung ngus ngo sprad// thos bsam gyi shes rang can rnams sna tshogs pa'i lam du bcud de/ kho rang gis shes pa'i tshig la brtan nas ngo sprad/ sgom chen pa la kho rang sngar goms kyi thog tu 'jun du bcug la/ de'i gnyen po bshig pa'i rjes la ngo sprad/ sdig po che la blo gros 'brel med du bstan te/ rig pa gcer bu la dge sdig gis ma gos par ngo sprod do// de rnams kyi bcud kyis rang rig ye shes ngos bzung ba zhes bya ste/ rta rgod 'dul ba/ sems rgod 'jun pa/ sgrim sgrim nas klod pa/ bkang bkang nas 'phen pa'i gnad yin no// gnyis pa thun gyis ting 'dzin srang du gzhug pa la bzhi las/ dang po mnyam bzhag rtsa ba zin thun ring por khrid pa ni zin rtags dbang po zung thung*/ bzhin mdangs gsal/ gos kyi cha ga (327)'dar na mnyam bzhag gnad du tshud pa yin pas thun ring du khrid la ngo sprad do// gnyis pa rtsa ba ma zin na thun thung ngur khrid pa ni/ rtags de gsum ma byung bar mi 'gul sna bug g.yon mnyam bzhag ma chun pas bshig kyang rjes mi mthong ste/ thun thung ngur bcad nas khrid de drag tu sgrim zhing myur du glod do// gsum pa spyod lam gyi dus su thun dum bur khyer ba ni/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du rtsa ba'i nyams dran pas bzung*/ phaṭa ces dum bur bcud kyin rjen rten med du khyer la spyod lam bya'o// bzhi pa rtsam 'byongs nas thun rgyun bar khyer ba ni/ rtsa ba 'byongs/ gnyen po zhig /mnyam bzhag 'dres pa'i tshe bcud dang rtsal sbyong thun du gzhug mi dgos te/ ma bcos pa'i rang nyams la rgyun par gnas so// dran pas zin tsam las byar med/ gal te yengs kyang thabs kyis bcud mi dgos te/ dran pa zin tsam gyis rtsa ba rnyed nas 'ong ngo*// de ltar thun du 'jug pa'i tshe na/

gsal brdo ba la bshig /bzad rngob la 'phro bcad/ 'bad rdo ba la spyod lam dang bsre/ gnas pa rgyun mi bsring*/ nyams len dum bur khyer/ rjes thob rten med du bskyang bar bya'o// gsum pa rtsal sbyong gis bogs 'don pa la'ang bzhi las/ dang por yar rtsal sbyong ba ni/ gzugs dang gzugs med kyi khams su rig pa 'phangs te rtsal sbyangs lha gnas thams cad lam lam gsal btab cing bcud/ rjes gnyen pos bshig /des mtho ris kyi bde ba la mi zhen te/ lha yi longs spyod rnams rang bzhin spros bral du 'char ba'o// gnyis pa mar rtsal sbyang ba ni/ ngan song gsum gsal btab la rig pa dkrug cing rtsal sbyang*/ rjes gnyen po bshig /des ngan song gi sdug bsngal rnams rang bzhin (328)spros bral rtogs pas nyams ming ba'o// gsum pa rig pa phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du rtsal sbyangs pa ni/ rig pa skad cig kyang mi gnas par yul sna tshogs la rgyug tu bcug cing*/ rjes gnyen po bshig /des mtshan nyid bsam mi khyab kyi nyams skye bas yul snang thams cad spros bral du rtogs pa'o// bzhi pa rig pa rjen par rtsal sbyang ba ni/ rig pa 'dir gtad med par yul med du dkrug /dmigs med du bsgul ba'o// des kyang rtsa ba ma zin na rig pa 'jur bcad pa la bzhi las/ so gzug pa ni/ dar cig bar snang stong pa la bcud do// de nas gdong bzlog pa ni/ 'dir gtad med par drag tu dkrug go /de nas byungs gdab pa ni/ rig pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par thang gis rgyang ngo*// de'i ngang la blo go ra nas bda' ba ni/ shigs kyis 'jog pa'o// de dag gis phyag rgya chen po'i rlung thog babs su tshud pas gnyug ma'i don rjen par rtogs pa'o// de rnams ni mnyam bzhag tu rtsal sbyang ba'o// da rjes thob tu rtsal sbyang ba la/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum las/ gzhi ngar dang bcas pa ni/ dus gnas thams cad du rig pa ngar dang bcas pa/ mdangs dang bcas pa/

hrig chags par bya'o// lam rtsal dang bcas pa ni/ 'gro 'dug nyal sad gang gi tshe yang rig pa'i ngar ma shor bar bya/ rig pa g.yer zhing dkrug pa dar rlung gis bskyod pa ltar ro// 'bras bu byin rlabs thugs rje rno ngar dang bcas pa ni/ dmigs pa rnon po mtshon cha lta bur/ nad dang gdon/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gang la gtad pa thams cad rang sar grol te rang bzhin spros bral du lhag lhag 'char bas yul lam du longs nas grogs su shar ba yin no// bzhi pa sor bzhag dang*/ lnga pa la bzla gnyis (329)gnyis te thun mong du chos bzhi las/ dang po chun sar 'jug pa ni/ mnyam bzhag tu bcud kyis chun pa gal che ste/ ma chun na bshig kyang rjes mi gsal/ gal te bcud kyis rig pa ma chun na rtsal sbyong gis 'jun zhing*/ chun nas kyang nyams bogs dbyung ba'i phyir rtsal sbyang ngo*// de ltar bcud dang rtsal sbyong gi sems rgod 'dul ba ni/ bkang bkang nas 'phen pa'am/ sgrim sgrim nas glod pa lta bu yin gsung ngo*// gnyis pa shigs sar bshigs pa ni/ bcud dang rtsal sbyong gis 'bar rdob la shegs kyis bshigs pa yin no// mnyam gzhag gi gnyen po chags na sgom nyams kyis bcings nas gshis mi mthong bas/ lus kyi rtsol ba 'khrul 'khor bshig /ngag gi rtsol ba phaṭa ces bshig /sems kyi rtsol ba lhod kyis slod/ shigs kyis bshigs la/ blo bral rten med du bzhag go /gsum pa ngos 'dzin pa ni/ gnyen po bshigs pa'i shul du rjes ngos 'dzin pa yin te/ 'dis bcud dang rtsal sbyong gi rjes thams cad du ngo sprod do// de yang sgom blo bsam gtan gyi gnyen po shigs kyis bshig pa'i shul du/ 'das pa'i shes pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes/ da ltar gyi rig pa sang nge/ lhod de ba/ rang dngas su rjen ne ba 'di rang yin gsung ngo*// de yang ngo bo rig pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ mtshan nyid blo bral/ rjen pa/ gcer bur gnas pa/

'gyu ba chad nas ci sems cha med pa/ 'dus ma byas kyi rig pa mkha' dkyil lta bu/ yid 'gyu ba dang bral ba'i sgom du med pa de ngos zin pa'o// lar skabs 'dir dri ma/ rnam pa/ rtsa ba gsum ngos zin dgos pas/ dri ma ni/ ngan rtog sems can gyi blo ste/ (330)de rtsal sbyong gis gcod/ rtog pa gang skyes la bcud pa'o// rnam pa ni/ de ltar bcud cing rtsal sbyong ba'i rjes su bzang rtog nyams la zhen nas stong mi phod pa ste/ de las phaṭa ces gnyen po yang gzhig gi gdams pas bshig la blo bral du bzhag go /rtsa ba ni/ lta sgom dang nyams myong gang la'ang phaṭa ces rig pa rjen pa rten med du bzhag ste/ des ni rtsa ba'am/ gshis sam yin lugs ngos zin pa'o// bzhi pa la bzlo ba ni/ sngar bstan pa'i nam mkha' lam khyer gyi bcud kyis 'dir ngo sprad la/ de yang la bzla ba la gsum/ bshig pa la bzla ba ni/ nyams kyi la bzla ste/ myong blo thams cad bshig la bzhag /gdams pas la bzla ba ni/ nam mkha' lam khyer te/ 'dir ngo sprad/ rtog pas la bzla ba ni/ rtsa ba'i don lta bu de rtogs nas de las ma rtogs pa'i/ yar sangs rgyas la thob rgyu dang mar 'khor bar ltung sa med/ yid la bya ba'i chos zhig ched du byas pa'i tha snyad gtor/ 'du shes shig /dran pa gtor/ rtsa ba bral gnyen po 'gyel/ blo zad chos zad gzhi la spros pa dang bral bas rtsa ba med/ rtsa ba dmigs pa dang bral bas sgom pa med/ don du rnam pa dang bral bas nyams myong med/ 'khrul med rang sar grol bas rjes thob med/ kha yan/ go bral/ blo bral/ rten 'brel du rtogs pa'o// de ltar ngo sprod pa'i 'di skad ces gdams te/ mnyam bzhag ma chun par rjes thob la ngo mi sprad/ rtsal ma 'byongs par lam la mi sbyar/ thun du ma tshud par bla ma dang mi 'bral/ ngos ma zin gyi bar khrid 'bro mi bcad/ rtogs tshod ma skyes kyi bar du la mi bzla/ nyams ma rdzogs kyi bar yi ge mi bstan/

khrid byed dus gzhung mi bshad/ slob dpon mi byed pa la gdams pa'i tshad ma sbyin cig /ces gsungs so// (331)de rnams kyis don rgyud la brten nas lag khrid bcu drug gis ngo sprod pa gdams tshar ro// gnyis pa tshig gi brgyud pa la brten nas gnad bcu drug gis sgro 'dogs gcod pa la don lnga ste/ sems bskyed lam khyer gyis sems lam du khyer ba/ stong thun gyis gzhi bca' ba/ kha 'thor gyi don gyis mdo bzung ba/ khar phog snar phog gis gtan la dbab pa/ tha ma tha rgyas gnyis su la bzla ba'o// dang po la bzhi las/ lta yul shes pa ni/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gnyis la blta ba'o// lta thabs shes pa ni/ de gnyis kyi steng du thog babs su blta ba'o// mthong tshad shes pa ni/ lta ba mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du mthong ba'o// dpe dang phan yon shes pa ni/ dpe nor bu chu dngas lta bu dang*/ phan yon sgyu ma rnam dag tu grol ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ yod pa'i yod lugs ni/ sems nyid gnyug ma'i don de thams cad la khyab par yod pa'o// yin pa'i yin lugs ni/ ci yang ma yin pas/ cir yang khas blang du med pa'o// snang ba'i snang lugs ni/ rtogs ma rtogs kyis byed pas 'khor 'das gnyis su snang ba'o// rtogs pa'i rtogs lugs ni/ 'khor 'das spang blang med par rtogs pa'o// gsum pa la bzhi las/ shes bya gzhi med ni/ gshis gzhi med mtha' bral du gnas pa'o// ngo bo rten med ni/ bcud dang rtsal sbyong gi ngo sprad pa'i rjes blo bral rten med do// nyams myong 'gyur med ni/ rjes shes sangs rgyas kyi thugs mthong bas nyams myong la 'gyur ba med pa'o// mtshan ma rang grol ni/ snang ba tha mal gyi rtog pa gang skyes rang grol ba'o// bzhi pa la bzhi las/ rang sems mgo med mjug med ni sems nyid ngos bzung ba med pa'o// rnam rtog bral med 'phrad ni snang ba thug mal gyi rtog (332)pa go rims med par skye ba'o// gdams pa khar phog snar phog ni rtog pa gang skyes kyi steng du bcud pa'o// 'phos 'gyel du gtong ba'i lag len ni/

des rtog pa thams cad chos nyid du 'gro ba'o// lnga pa mtha' rgyas gnyis su la bzla ba ni/ kha 'thor gyi khongs su gtogs kyi gnas logs su bgrang du med do// rma'i lag khrid tshig brgyud kyi gnad dang bcas pa'i khrid yig rog bde gshegs chen po'i yi ge ltar zin thun du byas pa dar rgyas 'phel// oṃ swa sti/ bka' babs bar pa'i nang tshan gnyis pa so rig pa gcer mthong gi khrid la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jam dpal smra seng*/ bir+wa pa/ ār+ya de ba/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas/ so dge 'dun 'bar/ sha mi smon lam 'bar/ 'khrul zhig mes ston nam/ yang na/ sha mi nas chus pa dar brtson/ chus pa brtson seng*/ de dang mos ston gyis rog shes rab 'od/ de nas chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa sogs bka' babs dang po ltar las/ khyab bdag dpal 'byor phun tshogs la/ rje blo gros brtan pas gsan/ de las bdag gis thob/ yang skyes mchog pa'i lugs ltar na/ sha mi smon lam 'bar nas/ lce ston sher tshul/ ba ri sgom chen/ 'phrang kha jo btsun/ nyang po ba 'byung gnas ye shes/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ byang chub rdo rje/ rgya brag pa ye shes gzhon nu/ skyes mchog bsam gtan dpal/ de gnyis kas smra bcad pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ des kun mkhyen byang chub bzang po// de nas rgya sgom rdo rje gdan pa man chad 'dra'o// gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la tshogs bsags/ skyabs 'gro/ mi rtag sems bskyed/ bla (333)ma'i rnal 'byor/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa dang bzhi'o// mdun gyi nam mkhar dpag bsam gyi ljon shing yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su seng khri pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can rdor dril 'dzin pa gzi mdangs rgyas la zhal 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan pa de'i dbu thog tu 'jam dbyangs smra seng dang rdo rje 'chang*/

dam pa'i g.yas su bir+wa pa/ g.yon du ār+ya de ba mdun du klu sgrub/ rgyab tu su kha sid+dhi/ de dag gi mtha' bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang yi dam bla ma/ dam pa'i chos rnams glegs bam brtsegs pa'i rnam pa/ de mdun byang sems dang nyan rang 'phags pa/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong ye shes pa rnams sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad bya byed mthun par 'khod pas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dngos 'byor yid sprul dang*/ bdag pos bzung ma bzung thams cad bsdus shing*/ khyad par lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa thams cad blos blangs nas phul bar bsams la mchod pa'i tshig ci rigs par brjod cing khyad par maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ tshogs zhing de dag gi spyan sngar ci mdzad khyed shes kyi re ltos ling skyur gyis rang dang sems can thams cad kyis phyi nang gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro mgrin gcig tu byed par mos la// ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ deng nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes blo dang 'dres nges su 'bad nas/ mthar skyabs yul rnams (334)kyi gnas gsum las 'od zer dpag med byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /skyabs yul rnams kyi rdo rje gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ rje dam pas 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam tsa na ci yang dgos pa mi gda'/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam tsa na ci yang dgos pa mi gda'/ sems can gyi 'khrul pa la bsam tsa na snying rje btsan thabs su skye bar gda'/ zhes gsungs pas 'di ltar bsam ste/

ga re bdag gis rnyed dka'i mi lus rin po che thob tu zin kyang*/ skyes pa na 'chi ba las ma 'das/ tshe thar du lus pa ni su yang mi 'dug pas nges par 'chi/ de yang 'chi rkyen mang zhing gson rkyen nyung bas myur du 'chi/ nam 'chi cha med pas do nub shi na ci tsug byed/ mi 'chi ba'i gding ni med/ shi ba'i rjes su las kyi dbang gis 'khor ba mtho dman gang du skyes kyang skyid med/ des na 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang por skyes na chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du dran na brtson 'grus kyi lcag byed/ tha mar dran na mi rtag pa dran pa dang chos nyid du go ba dus mnyam pa yin gsung*/ de ltar 'chi ba mi rtag pa gsha' ma zhig dran na sems can la snying rje bcos min du skye ste/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can 'di thams cad kyis bdag gi pha ma lan grangs dpag tu med pa byas pa'i drin can sha stag yin pa la/ 'di thams cad kyang 'chi ba ma dran pas/ rang rang gi tshe 'di ltos kyi 'du 'dzi la g.yengs nas/ chos mi dran pa 'di dag snying re rje/ 'di dag sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral nas/ bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu la bdag nyid kyis 'god/ de'i ched du bdag gis dge sbyor la 'bad par bya'o snyam pas/ ma nam mkhar (335)dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rig pa dri ma med pa'i don sgom par bya'o// zhes brjod cing don bsam mo// gsum pa ni/ rje dam pas/ gsol ba mos gus kyis thob cig /byin rlabs rang 'bar du 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod/ ces dang*/ mos gus kyis byin rlabs chun na rgyud rang grol la 'gro/ zhes dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba dang byin rlabs zhugs pa dus mnyam zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sku gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ sku gzi mdangs rgyas shing*/ zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa/ thugs 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas byin rlabs 'bad rtsol med par stsol ba zhig sgom nas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ yi dam lha tshogs/ nyan rang 'phags pa/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad spyan drangs nas bstim ste/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bsgom/ de la rang gis byang drangs te/ sems can thams cad kyis sgo gsum gus pas ci mdzad khyed shes kyi gsol ba 'debs par mos la/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so// rig pa dri med du rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ci nus dang*/ spro na/ na mo gu ru/ brag seng ge 'dra ba'i gnas mchog tu/ zhes sogs brgyud 'debs kyang 'don/ mthar rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag /dbang bzhi thob/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs (336)kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam zhing*/ bla ma rang la bstim nas 'dzin med blo bral gyi ngang la rang lugs su mnyam par bzhag /bzhi pa ni/ dam pas/ rgyud ma smin pa'i rten la byin rlabs kyi rtsi mi chags pas/ thog mar rgyud sbyong ba 'di ḍom+bhi pa'i gdams ngag yin/ zhes dang*/ rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ 'bras bu sku gsum thob pa dus mnyam/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'jug sgo'i gtor dbang bskur nas/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la rang nyid jo bo spyan ras gzigs dkar po phyag bzhi pa'i rnam pa can du bskyed pa la yi dam thams cad spyan drangs la bstim/ dbang bskur bas spyi bor rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med sgom/ de yang*/ rnam pa gsal zhing ra rang rgyal brtan pas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs/ rnam dag dran pas lha snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur rgyas btab ste gsal stong du bsgom pas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'o// de ltar zung 'jug tu shes pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnad gsum ste/

bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ dgang ba rlung gi gnad/ bzhag pa sems kyi gnad do// dang po ni/ dam pas/ nyams myong skye bar 'dod na lus la rten 'brel sgrigs/ zhes pas lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan las mi g.yo bar 'ching ste/ brda' rgyud las/ chos bdun tshul gyis rlung sems tshang du gzhug /ces gsungs/ lta stangs ni/ dang po dma' bar bya/ de nas je mthor bslab pas gegs chung zhing yon tan che/ de yang sems ma zin gyi bar nyan thos kyi spyan zhi ba mthar ltas kyis sems bzung*/ zin pa dang byang sems thad ka'i lta stangs kyis so mar glod/ nyams la chags na khro bo'i lta stangs phyogs bcur bsgyur bas (337)rjes shes ngo sprad do// gnyis pa ni/ dam pas/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga gtod la mnan pas/ yan lag gi rlung lnga las su rung ste/ rten 'brel gyi 'char sgo du ma rtogs pa 'di ni karma badz+ra gyi gdams pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas 'byung 'jug gnas gsum so mar bzhag pas rlung bcu dbang du 'du'o// gsum pa la/ dbang po rab khyab brdal chen po'i ngang la bzhag pa/ dbang po 'bring gcer mthong thug phrad la bzhag pa/ dbang po tha ma bcun thabs sna tshogs kyis bcun nas bzhag pa dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ lus gnad bca'/ sems khong glod de/ gang yang yid la mi byed par so ma lhug pa/ ma bcos par rang sor 'jog /dam pas/ ma bcos pa cog ge bzhag go /bcos na rta las babs nas bong bur zhon pa 'dra/ zhes gsungs pas/ rnam rtog skyes na/ de la lta yang mi lta/ rjes su yang mi 'brang*/ rang sor ma bcos par bzhag /gsal rdo ba la shigs se bshig ste rang lugs su bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ smra seng gis dam pa la gsungs pa las/ gang shar la cher gyis ltos/ yin thog tu lhun gyis bzhog /zin tsa na bshig la bor/ de nyid la rtsal sbyongs/ gang byung thog tu khur/ zhes gsungs/ 'di la gnyis las/ phyi snang ba gang shar nyams su blang ba ni/ dbang po ma bkag par tshogs drug gi yul du gang shar de la gcer gyis bltas la/

rang bzhin med par mthong ba de'i steng du lhan gyis 'jog /gsal rdo ba la phaṭa ces bshig nas tha mal rang sor bzhag /de ltar bzhag pas/ gdangs ma 'gags la/ gshis cir yang ma grub pa'i thal le ba/ snang stong dbyer med du rtogs pa de la rang byung gi ye shes zer ba yin pas rgyun du nyams su blang ngo*// nang rig pa gang shar nyams su blang ba ni/ sa ra has (338)dam pa la gsungs pa las/ sems nyid me long gzugs brnyan shar ba de/ rkyen shar yin gyis don la ma skyes kyai/ zhes pas/ sems la rnam rtog gang shar yang ngo bo cir 'dug cer gyis ltos/ bltas pas rnam rtog sogs rags pa rnams snang stong grag stong du 'char/ phra ba rnams rang dwangs rang stong du sing sing 'gro/ de'i steng du lhan gyis bzhog /gsal stong du bshig la rang sor bzhag go /bde sdug rkyen snang ci byung yang de ltar nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa la/ mtshan bcas dang*/ mtshan med gnyis/ dang po la gsum las/ snang ba gtsub stan lta bu la/ rig pa gtsub shing lta bus rno bton te rig pa ye shes gcer mthong du ngo sprod pa ni/ in+d+ra bo dhis dam pa la gsungs pa'i gdams pa ste/ rang gi mdun du/ shing bu'am rde'u lta bu dmigs rten gyi mtshan ma gcig bzhag la/ de la lta stangs dang rig pa bcun nas thad kar gtad/ rig pa la ngar bskyed/ dbang po la bkrag bton nas hrig ge bzhag /gsal rdo tsa na shigs se bshig la rang sor bzhag go /mtshan mo snying 'od kyi gong bu'i nang du bla ma'i sku chung la dod pa dgyes pa'i zhal mdangs yal le ba/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngon po 'bar ba la yid gtad de sngar bsgom pa'o// lta stangs kyis rig pa 'gal me ltar bskor nas rig pa ye shes gcer mthong du ngo sprad pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu pas dam pa la gsungs pa ste/ drag rlung btsan thabs su bzung*/ lta stangs bcun/ rig pa mdun gyi nam mkhar 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar bskor ba la yid drag tu gtad/

gsal rdo ba la phaṭa ces bshig nas lhod klod la rang sor bzhag go /lta stangs kyis rig pa mdung tshugs su nye ring gsum la gtad de rig pa ye shes gcer mthong du ngo sprad pa ni/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes dam pa la gsungs pa ste/ rang gi mdun du dmigs (339)rten nye ba khru do tsam/ bar pa khang mtshams tsam/ ring ba ri rtse lta bur mtshan ma byas pa la/ lta stangs bcun nas rig pa mdud btsug pa ltar gtad de/ gsal rdo ba la phaṭa ces bshig nas rang sor bzhag go /gnyis pa mtshan med la'ang gsum las/ steng dang 'og gi lta stangs kyis rig pa ye shes cer mthong du ngo sprad pa'o// shes rab bzang po'i gdams pa ste/ rang lus yi dam gyi sku'i rnam pa la/ nang khog pa stong sang nge ba zo stong zhabs med pa lta bur bsam la/ lta stangs bcun te rig pa tshangs bug nas yar rgyang gis bton te 'og min du thal le btang la bzhag /gsal rdo ba la phaṭa ces bshig nas rang sor bzhag /yang rig pa 'og sgo nas mar rgyang gis bton te gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar thal le btang la bzhag /gsal rdo ba la bshig nas rang sor bzhag /de ka la su ni bhi ka mas/ rig pa bya 'phur dum bu'i gnad// lta stangs 'jog dor res mor gyis// mi rtog ltengs po bsrungs nas ni// tha mal dngos zhen ldog par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// rig pa 'gyur med du bcing nas gcer mthong du ngo sprad pa ni/ tog rtse ba'i gdams pa ste/ rig pa la dar bton nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar lta stangs kyis rig pa 'gyur med du gtad/ gsal rdo ba la phaṭa ces bshig nas bzhag /de ltar thun chung la grangs mang bar bsgom/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis mda' ltar 'phang zhing*/ gzhu ltar bkug nas nam mkha' ltar skye med du rig pa ye shes cer mthong du ngo sprad pa ni/ bir+wa pa'i gdams pa ste/ rang gi mdun na phar lta stangs kyis sems mda' ltar rgyangs kyis 'phangs nas nam mkha' dang bsres la rgya skyed de bzhag

/gsal rdo ba la (340)bshig la/ lta stangs nang du blta zhing sems tshur bkug la de kha'i ngang du lhod kyis slod de ma bcos par bzhag /de ltar res yun thung la thun mong bar sgom/ res thun ring la grangs nyung bar sgoms// de ltar dbang po dang bstun nas nyams su blangs pas rang rig mtha' bral bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i ye shes la rgyun du gnas pa 'byung na ngo sprad pa bya ste/ de la ngo sprad pa'i thabs gsum ste/ dbang po rab ye shes btsan thabs su ngo sprad/ 'bring dpe dang tshig gis ngo sprad/ tha ma yid ches tshig la brtan nas ngo sprad pa'o// dang po ni/ lus gnad bca'/ rlung bzung*/ rig pa dpangs bstod la shes pa rang sor bzhag go /de ltar bzhag pas shes pa ma bcos pa'i so ma 'di ka rang rig dri med chos sku bya ba de yin no// de yang sngar ma rig pa da rig pas rang rig gzung 'dzin gang gis kyang ma gos pas dri med sems kyi yin lugs/ ye gdod ma nas de ltar rang chas su gnas pas chos sku'o// de ltar yang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa// zhes dang*/ smra seng gi don rgyud las/ tshogs bsags skal ldan gang zag dang*// bla ma dam pa 'phrad tsa na// bla mas mtshan nyid ngo sprad pas// chos nyid ye shes sgom tsa na// sgom ma myang la 'bral ma myong*// ma bsgom don dang mi 'bral ba'i// ye shes chen po rgyun chad med// rnal 'byor mchog gi ting 'dzin yin// dbang po rab kyi ngo sprod do// zhes dang*/ dam pas/ rig pa dri med sgom pa la blos sgom gyi zhabs tog mi bya/ zhabs 'dren du 'gro/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po chu'i chu lbur ltar ngo sprad pa ni/ chu'i chu lbur de byung yang chu las byung*/ gnas kyang chu'i ngo bor gnas/ thim yang chu la thim pa ltar/ rang (341)gi rtog pa tol gyis skyes dus kyang*/ sems gsal stong chos sku las skyes/

gnas dus kyang gsal stong chos sku'i ngo bor gnas/ 'gags dus kyang gsal stong chos sku'i ngang du 'gags pa yin no// dam pas/ 'das pa'i rtog pa'ang chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang du grol/ ma 'ongs pa'i rtog pa'ang chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang du 'char/ da ltar gyi rtog pa'ang chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang du gnas pa yin/ zhes dang*/ rig pa cer mthong gi gdams pa gang lags zhus pas/ tol skyes kyi shes pa ngos bzung dang bral ba de la zer/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa sos ka'i me tog ltar ngo sprod pa ni/ dper na sos ka'i me tog la mtshan mo char babs nas snga dro'i nyi ma'i 'od phog pa dang me tog kha dog dwangs pa/ gsal ba/ dwangs gsal mi phyed par bkra ba/ mdog gzhan du mi 'gyur ba ltar/ rig pa la ngar thogs pas gsal ba dwangs pa/ gsal stong dbyer mi phyed pa kho'i rang bzhin 'gyur med du hrig gis gnas pa/ de ka chos sku yin te/ tha mal gyi shes pa sgom du shar ba zer ba yin no// smra seng gi don rgyud las// de nyid gnyug ma'i ngang la dwangs// de nyid gnyug ma'i ngang la gsal// de nyid gnyug ma'i ngang la dbyer mi phyed// de nyid gnyug ma'i ngang las mi 'gyur ba// tha mal shes pa rang bzhin du sgom shes pa'o// zhes so// gsum pa tshig gis ngo sprad pa ni/ da ltar gyi shes pa so ma/ ma bcos pa/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba/ de ka rang rig dri med chos sku phyag rgya chen po bya ba yin te/ rje dam pas/ rtog pa snga ma 'gags/ phyi ma ma skyes pa'i rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ da ltar gyi shes pa la gsal le/ hrig ge ba des chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ rtag chad gnyis dang bral ba de/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa de (342)rang yin/ zhes gsung ngo*// ngo mtshar brgyud pa'i bka' babs las kyang*/ ngo sprod gcig gi yul la rtsa bzin ba pas/ zab mo'i don phyogs med du mthong bar byed/ 'tshang rig pa go rtogs kyis gnad zung zhig

/ces so// des na dbang po tha ma'i ngo sprod ni/ rang gi rig pa snga ma 'gags shing phyi ma ma skyes pa'i da ltar ba/ so ma rang rig pa ma bcos ma slad pa 'di ka sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa chos sku phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa bya ba yin te/ dam pas so chung ba la/ khyod rang gi mig gi thad ka'i nam mkha' la cer re ltos la lta byed kyi shes pa de nyid la ltos dang*/ de'i dus na rnam par rtog pa thams cad bral ba ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa'i nyams shig 'char/ de ma shar na nga la gdams ngag gi gnad med pa yin no// zhes dang*/ tol te skyes pa'i shes pa la cer de bltas pas bun zhig nas/ lhag gis 'char ba chos nyid yin// zhes gsungs/ yang 'di skad du/ gzhan dag stong pa lam du byed de/ nga cag rig pa lam du byed// ces dang*/ gzhan dag mi rtog pa lam du byed de/ nga cag rtog pa lam du byed// ces so// gsum pa rjes la gnyis te/ drod tshad blta zhing gegs bsal ba dang*/ bogs 'don zhing man ngag gi chings bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis las drod blta ba ni/ bla mas ngo sprad kyang ma 'phrod par nges shes ma skyes na bo ba'i rtags/ dang po nges shes cung zad skyes kyang skyong ma shes na zags/ nyams su len shes kyang g.yeng bas mi bskyang bar dred na ltems/ skyon yon yod bzhin du log par 'dzin pas nyams su mi len na log pa yin pas ngo shes par byas la 'bad par bya/ gnyis pa la gegs bsal ba la bying rgod gnyis las/ bying ba ni/ rig pa rmugs 'thibs su song ba ste/ de bsal ba la chung 'bring che gsum gyi/ chung ngus nyams de la ngo bo ci 'dug (343)yang yang blta zhing nyams su blang*/ 'bring de byung dus phaṭa sogs lus ngag gi spyod pa sna tshogs bya zhing*/ rjes kyi shes pa ngos bzung la bsgom/ chen po ni/ sgom blo phyir bsal te/ sgom khyed rang de ring phan chad/ nga cag la dpag tshad kyi pha rol du song la/

nga can ma 'ong zhig byas la rgyang gis skyur te/ gang shar de la rang rjen par khres se bzhag /de ltar yang yang byas pas rang gsal 'dzin med du 'char/ de yang bshig cing bskyang ngo*// rje dam pas/ rdza chu drag po rdabs kyin dwangs// dngul dkar me long phyis kyin gsal// rnal 'byor shes pa bshig kyin bzang*// zhes gsung ngo*// gnyis pa la gnyis kyi dang po ngos bzung ba ni/ spyir rnam pa mang na'ang*/ rgod pa ni/ rnam rtog hrags por 'phro zhing gnas su ma gtub pa/ 'phro ba ni/ mi dran/ dgu dran/ phra ba/ sna tshogs 'phro ba/ 'thor ba ni/ sgom pa yin pa tsug 'dug kyang shes pa ma chun pas 'phro ba chu zangs kyi nya lta bu/ yas pa ni/ gnas pa srabs pas chu zangs kyi snye ma lta bu ste/ rigs dang yon tan sogs kyis dregs shing nga rgyal ba'i 'pho ba dang*/ nga 'dra bas chos 'di nyams su mi long snyam pa zhum zhing sgyid lug pa'i 'phro ba'o// gnyis pa gegs de bsal tshul ni/ rim bzhin te shes pas kyang kun sel mod/ 'on kyang khyad par gyi gnad yul gang yang rung ba la lta stangs bcun/ sems khong glod/ stod smad kyi nywa bzhi sgrims pas snga ma gsum sel la/ yas pa ni de nyid las ma yengs par rig pa bcun pas sel zhing*/ rigs dang yon tan de nyid rtsa ba bcad de/ rang las gzhan su yang med pa'am/ lhag par blo gding thub pa ci 'dug blta/ gzhan gyi yon tan bsam nas mnyam par bzhag go /zhum pa la bla mar gsol ba btab cing (344)rig pa la ngar bskyed pas sel lo// gnyis pa la gnyis kyi dang po bogs 'don pa la/ de ltar gegs bsal zhing nyams su blangs kyang bskyed med na/ ngo bo rang bzhin/ mtshan nyid gsum gyis ngo sprod cing bogs 'don te/ dang po ngo bo ni/ ngo bo rang rig gsal la brtan pa de/ gsal ba'i dpe ma tog kha phye ba lta bu dang chu rnyog pa dwangs pa lta bu dang*/ bcu drug gi nam langs pa lta bu'o// brtan pa'i dpe rus sbal 'khar gzhong du bzhag pa lta bu ni/

zhig nas ma thug pas nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa'o// gar sbyin la sbrang ma 'byar ba lta bu ni/ rtog pa'i phu thag chod kyang sangs dwangs nas 'gro ma nus pa lta bu'o// 'dag pa smin po la rdo rgyab pa lta bu ni/ nyams phyi bshig nang bshig nas bzhag na'ang gang bzhag la sdod pa'o// rang bzhin gsal ba shed che ba'i dpe/ rigs drug gi g.yang sa la nyam nga dang bral ba khyung nam mkha' la 'phyo ba lta bu/ theg pa gzhan la nyam nga dang bral ba seng ge rtsal rdzogs pa lta bu/ rig pa rkyen gyis bslur mi 'dod pa dar chen rlung gis bskyod pa lta bu'i nyams 'char ro// mtshan nyid stong gsal dwangs pa'i dpe/ kun la khyab cing mtha' dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu/ mnyam rjes rgyun mi chad par yong ba chu bo chen po lta bu/ gnyen po bkol du btub pa shel yungs 'bru tsam la gzugs brnyan 'char ba lta bu'o// mdor na/ ngo bo mnyam bzhag /rang bzhin rjes thob/ mtshan nyid mnyam rjes zung 'jug gi rtogs pa'o// yang*/ dbang po rab ngo 'phrod pa tsam gyis rtogs thob dus gcig tu grol ba/ 'bring dran pa tsam gyis snang rtog thams cad ye shes su 'char ba/ tha ma lus gnad lta stangs kyi sgo nas thun chung la grangs mang bar nyams su blangs pas dbang po tha ma 'bring du 'gro/ 'bring rab tu 'gro'o// gnyis pa la gnyis kyi/ dang po 'gyur (345)med thag chod lta ba man ngag gi chings ni/ rang rig dri med chos skur thag chod pa na/ mkhas pa shes rab can gyis kyang*/ de nyid las lhag pa'i grub mtha' blos dpyad pas ma rnyed de/ yid ches dad gus kyis 'di ltar sgom pas don rtogs nas yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed pa'o// gnyis pa myur mgyogs 'khyogs med sgom pa man ngag gi chings ni/ nyams len dran pa'i lam gyi snang rtog thams cad ye shes su 'char bas na/ 'di nyid sgom pas 'bras bu tshe gcig gis thob pas mgyogs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin pas gzhan du 'khyogs pa med pa'o// gsum pa brtan pa mthar phyin 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'i chings ni/

rang rig dri med chos skur ngo sprad pas/ yid ches nas nyams len mthar phyin tsa na/ sangs rgyas gzhan nas 'tshol mi dgos par rang yin pa mngon du 'gyur ba'o// bzhi pa gnas skabs blo ldog 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi chings ni/ gang shar dri med du bskyang zhing*/ sa shas chen rlung gis ro snyoms pa sogs 'byung ba ro snyoms dang*/ de yang gnas/ longs spyod/ spyod lam/ kha zas/ grogs/ ting 'dzin thams cad la ched 'dzin spangs la ro snyoms pa'o// lnga pa drod tshad 'dzin pa sman pa mkhas pa lta bu'i chings ni/ las dang po pas thun chung la grangs mang bar bsgom zhing*/ goms pa spyod lam dang bsre/ smin nas gnas grogs spyod lam thams cad nges med du bskyang ngo*// de yang phyi nang gi chos thams cad khrol shes pa rgya 'bag gi mig lta bu ste/ phyi nang gsang ba na tsha bde sdug thams cad gang shar kho rang gi steng du nyams su blangs pas rang rig dri med chu rgyun lta bus sgrib gnyis bag chags kyi dri ma dag pa'o// drug pa nyams rtogs mthar phyin gser (346)gling du phyin pa lta bu'i chings ni/ gser gling du rdo phal pa mi rnyed pa ltar/ rnal 'byor pa nyams rtogs kyi rtsal rgyas pa la/ snang rtog thams cad chos nyid skye med du nyams su myong zhing*/ rnam rtog btsal yang mi rnyed par chos nyid du mthar phyin par 'gyur ro// bdun pa dgos 'dod 'byung ba nor bu rin po che lta bu'i chings ni/ de ltar nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa de la/ zas nor dgos dgu gang 'dod 'byung ba lta ci smos/ las dang sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma sangs nas/ thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob cing*/ sku gnyis zung 'jug gi phrin las kyis don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ba'o// brgyad pa dga' brod 'chi kha nyams len gyi chings ni/ nam 'chi ba'i tshe gnyen nor sogs gang la chags kyang 'ching bas/ bdag shi phan chod gzhan gyi nor yin pas su dga' gyis/

gnyen nor la chags kyang las zad smon lam gyi 'phen pa rdzogs pas skad cig 'grogs pa'i dbang ni med/ des na gang dga' gyis snyam du zhen chags thams cad rbad kyis bcad/ mgo brgya'i nang nas rang mgo 'don pa'i dpe ltar nyams len la 'bung gsum 'don/ yengs med du bskyang*/ 'chi ltas rnams shes par byas nas blta zhing*/ de nyid la nyams len 'phral med du bya'o// lus la zhen pa spang zhing yi dam sgom/ sems gang shar ngo shes 'bral med brten/ zhum na rig pa stong pa la 'chi rgyu med/ gang snang dri med chos sku yin pas gzengs bstod/ da man ngag zab mo 'di 'dra dang 'grogs nas 'chi bas 'od gsal chos skur 'tshang rgya ba yin pas re dga' snyam du ngar bskyed la/ bying rmugs su mi btang*/ 'tsher ngas dang 'jigs snang byung na/ 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed// ces gsungs pas lus (347)longs spyod thams cad rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba med par sems can thams cad kyi don du bla ma dkon mchog yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung la phul nas bla ma spyi bor sgom/ rang yi dam du gsal btab nas/ bdag sems can thams cad kyi don du 'chi khar 'od gsal chos sku thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bar do'i ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang rnams dag pa longs skur shar nas longs skur thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skye ba sprul skur shes bzhin du skye ba blangs nas sku gsum dbyer med sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab nas/ bdag gis bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa'i mthu dang*/ gdams pa zab mo nyams su blangs pas mtshams sbyar nas 'chi kha'am/ bar do'am/ sems can gyi don du sprul skur skye ba blangs te/ gzhan don rlabs chen bya snyam du sems bskyed nas 'khrul snang gang gi yang rjes su mi 'brang bar yengs med du nyams su blangs/

de ltar nyams su blangs pas sngar gyi 'dun pa drag po dang ngo shes kyis skyel ma byas/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags pa'i 'od gsal gyis bsun ma byas nas/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa bzhin/ the tshom med par ma bu 'phrod pa'i 'od gsal de las lhag pa'i rtogs bya gzhan med pas/ de da res thob pa re dga' snyam du bsam la/ 'chi rtags/ thim rtags/ 'od gsal rnams 'byung rim nas ngo shes par byas nas de kha'i ngang la ma bcos par bskyang ngo*// 'di ni 'od gsal gyi 'pho ba'am/ rab bla ma'i 'pho ba bya ba mchog tu gyur pa'o// gnyis pa de ltar nyams su blangs pas ji ltar grol tshul ni dbang rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas pa mun pas bar ma chod par je gsal la 'gro ba tshes bcu drug gi nam langs pa lta bur sangs rgyas thob/ (348)'bring bar dor 'tshang rgya ba skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par chu la 'or pa rgyab pas zhig steng chu rgyun ma chad par 'byung ba ltar sangs rgyas thob/ tha ma skye ba blangs nas 'tshang rgya ba/ ngo sprod la yid ches brtan cing goms pas rgyun mthud nas byang sems shes bzhin du skye ba blangs te sems can gyi don byed pa ltar sangs rgyas thob/ des na tshe 'di'am/ 'chi kha'am bar do/ skyes nas sangs rgyas mi thob pa mi srid pas gdams pa khyad par du 'phags pa la yid ches pas nyams len la brtson pa gces so// so rig pa gcer mthong gi khrid yig ding ri ba dpal ldan bsod nams kyi yi ge la gzhi byas khyab bdag dpal 'byor phun tshogs kyi zin ris nas legs cha blangs te zin thun du byas pa dar rgyas 'phel// oṃ swa sti/ bka' babs bar ba'i nang tshan gsum pa skam lugs sher phyin snying po don gyi khrid bya ba ste/ bla ma sngon ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes su khrid 'di sngon la btang nas skam lugs kyi khrid gzhan rnams mdzad pa yin kyang*/ da lta 'di nyid ma gtogs gzhan rnams la lung tsam las khrid rgyun ma bzhugs so// 'di la gnyis te/

bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ thub dbang*/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ bram ze ār+ya de ba/ rje dam pa sangs rgyas/ skam ston ye shes rgyal mtshan/ khu ston dbang phyug bla ma/ chag ston rin chen grub/ stod ston shākya seṅge/ zhang ston dar ma bsod nams/ rje ko brag pa/ mtshan ldan ri khrod dbang phyug /mkhan chen dus gsum sangs rgyas/ drin can sangs rgyas dbon/ kun mkhyen sku mched man bka' babs dang po dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa snying po don gyi khrid la don drug ste/ gsol ba gdab pa/ mos gus bya ba/ sgrib (349)pa sbyong ba/ tshogs bsags pa/ byams snying rje bsgom pa/ sems bskyed don gyi khrid do// dang po ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan mtho zhing yangs pa la rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de'i dbu thog nas yar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor sangs rgyas byang sems rnams sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos la/ mos gus drag pos maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa ci rigs pa 'bul ba sngon du 'gro bas/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rin po che rnams mkhyen/ bdag la theg pa chen po'i chos rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ci nus dang*/ spro na/ na mo gu ru/ bya rgod phung po'i ri bo ru/ zhes brgyud 'debs kyang 'don/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rim gyis 'od du zhu ste rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par bsam la mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la bsdus nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rang gi spyi bor pad nyi zla ba'i gdan steng byon nas bzhugs par bsam la/ bla ma dam pas bdag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las drangs te thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang la 'god par mdzad pa yin pas bka' drin che snyam du re ltos ling skyur gyi mos gus tshad med pa dung dung pa bsgom par bya'o// gsum pa ni/

bla ma de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas mar zhugs te snying 'od kyi gur khang gi nang du bzhugs par bsam la/ mos gus dung pa byas pas de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan zer re re 'phros/ des rang gi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa rnams ded de ba spu'i (350)khung bu nas dud pa ltar thon te song ba rang lus shel sgong phyis pa ltar dag par bsam pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba yangs shing rgya che bar bsam/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas bla ma dang dkon mchog spyan drangs nas gzhal yas khang du bzhugs par mos/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs nas sngar ltar zhugs/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams spyan drangs nas de dag gi 'khor du bzhugs par bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas rigs drug gi sems can rnams bkug pa dang*/ yang 'od zer gyis gnod byed gdon bgegs rnams bkug ste/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i 'khor yug la rim par 'khod par bsam mo// de nas rang gi lus 'di che zhing tshol snum pa gzhon mdzes yid du 'ong ba de nyid 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ro mchog brgya pa 'dod yon gyi rnam pa cir yang 'char ba'i mchod rdzas su byin gyis brlabs te/ yar bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la rim gyis phul/ mar 'gro drug gi sems can dang gnod byed lan chags kyi mgron rnams la sbyin pas thams cad mnyes shing tshim par gyur pa la dga' spro sgom par bya'o// lnga pa ni/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du de thams cad sems can gyis go mtshams med par gang bas sems can la'ang mtha' med/ sems can de thams cad kyis bdag gi pha ma lan grangs dpag tu med pa zhig byas/

byas res bzhin rang gi tshe 'di'i mas ji ltar phan gdags pa bzhin du de thams (351)cad kyis phan tshad med btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin ang snyam du bsam pa ni byams pa sgom pa'o// drin can gyi pha ma 'di rnams mi 'dod bzhin du 'khor ba'i gnas su sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bas nyams thag par ma zad/ da dung sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la tsham tshom med par 'jug pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ bdag gi pha ma sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras la spyod pa 'di kun ci tsug rang bya/ zhes sems can sdug bsngal myong ba la mi bzod pa'i sems snying gas gas su ci drag gang drag gi tshul du bsam pa snying rje sgom pa'o// de ltar byams snying rje sgom ste snying rje'o zhes snying rje sar bzhag pas mi phan/ 'di dag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral te/ thar pa bla na med pa'i myang 'das mchog la 'god par bya'o snyam du drag tu sgom mo// drug pa mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob gnyis las/ dang po mnyam bzhag tu rnam par rtog pa btsan thabs su gcod pa ni/ stan bde ba la lus gnad chos bdun bca'/ ngag gnad rlung so mar bzhag /sems kyi gnad 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi rtog pa thams cad rbad kyis bcad nas/ ngos bzung med pa'i sems gtad med kyis gshis lugs de kha'i ngang la sa le seng nge ma bcos par bzhag /de las rtog pa gya gyu ba 'gyu na rang sar rbad bcad la rtog med du sing nge bzhag go /gsum pa rjes thob tu rnam par rtog pa chos nyid du khyer ba ni/ sngar rtog med du bzhag pa'i shes pa de dang*/ phyis yul rkyen gyis bskyed pa'i rtog pa de gcig tu 'dug gam tha dad du 'dug brtags pas/ de gnyis po so so tha dad du mi 'dug ste/ gcig gi ngo bo las ma 'das par thag bcad nas bskyang bar bya ba gnad do// de ltar mnyam rjes dbyer med du gyur ma gyur sogs bla ma (352)nyams myong can brten nas blo thag bcad par bya'o// skam lugs don gyi khrid yig rnying las cung zad go bde bar bcos pa'o// zhi byed kyi khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu las/

bka' babs par pa rma so skam gsum gyi khrid yig bshad pa'i le tshan no// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhi byed chos kyi rtsa ba bka' babs phyi ma las bsgo ba'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i gdams pa las/ 'dir bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga'i lugs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams ngag /gsang sngags dang rjes su mthun pa/ rtsa brgyud la bskur ba snying po don gyi ngo sprod/ thabs rten 'brel gyi che ba du mas brgyan nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa thams cad gdan gcig gi steng du dus gcig la nyams su len pa'i man ngag /dri med thig pa phyag gzhes kyi skor zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la don lnga ste/ yid ches bskyed pa bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ rten ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang*/ nyams myong ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa khrid/ rtogs pa ma shar ba shar bar byed pa bla ma'i byin rlabs/ spros pa ma chod pa chod par byed pa tshig tshogs kyi don rnams so// dang po ni/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ longs sku lha mo bdag med ma/ thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro nyer bzhi/ dpal ldan sum cu rtsa drug /grub thob lnga bcu rtsa lnga la/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas/ skye med byang sems kun dga'/ mkhas btsun spa tshab sgom pa/ grub thob rgyal ba te ne/ chos rgyal nyi seng sku mched/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams dpal/ rgyal sras kun dga' sku mched nas/ mtshan ldan ri khrod dbang phyug /mkhan chen tshul khrims phan/ drin (353)can bsod nams dbon/ yang na/ rgya ston smon lam shes rab/ de gnyis la chos rje kun mkhyen sku mched kyis gsan/ de nas/ rgya sgom rdo rje gdan pa/ byang sems rgya mtsho sbyin pa/ sku gsum bde chen lhun grub bam/ yang na/ kun mkhyen byang chub bzang po nas/ chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho/ ras chen dpal ldan bsod nams/

thugs sras bsod nams 'od zer/ lung chen pa bsod nams dpal bzang*/ sku gsum bde chen lhun grub bo// de nas mkhas grub nam mkha' bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor lhun grub/ khyab bdag dpal 'byor phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bkra shis bzang po/ ding ri mkhas grub blo gros brtan pa/ des bdag dharma shrī la'o// de rnams kyi rnam thar lo rgyus ni gzhan las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ lus smin byed bum dbang ni/ mthong bas chog pa'i rtsi ste/ phung khams skye mched rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la brten nas phyi yul la dag snang sbyong bar byed pa'i gnad do// ngag smin byed gsang dbang ni/ zin pas chog pa'i rtsi ste/ 'khor lo bzhi'i yig 'bru la brten nas nang 'dzin pa yid sgrib bam bag chags sbyong ba'i gnad do// sems smin byed sher dbang ni/ shes pas chog pa'i gnad de/ 'khrul 'khor bzhi la brten nas ye shes bzhi rgyud la skye bar byed pa'i gnad do// yid smin byed tshig dbang ni/ 'phrad pas chog pa'i brgyud pa ste/ yig 'bru'i gnad bzhi la brten nas sa lam gnyen pos gcod cing bgrod par bya ba'i gnad yin te/ de rnams dbang chog las shes par bya'o// gsum pa la bzhi ste/ lam dkar khrid blo sbyong (354)gcig pu la 'bud pa dang*/ dmar khrid lam lnga'am lam gsum nyams su len pa/ nag khrid yi ge rigs la rtogs par byed pa/ de rnams kyang dka' thub kyi srang nas 'don pa'o// bzhi pa la bzhi ste/ dang por bla ma chos skur gsol ba thebs na rtogs pa phyogs med du 'char/ bar du bla ma longs skur gsol ba thebs na yon tan phyogs med du 'char/ tha mar bla ma sprul skur gsol ba thebs na 'gro don phyogs med du 'byung*/ rjes la bla ma bde ba chen po'i skur gsol ba thebs na sangs rgyas kyi phrin las zad 'phel med par 'byung ba yin no// lnga pa la bzhi ste/ mdo rgyud phyag len dang bcas pa/

bka' babs snyan brgyud dang bcas pa/ dri med phra thig dang bcas pa/ dar tshags bshad 'bum dang bcas pa rnams so// de dag las 'dir gang bshad par bya ba ni/ nyams myong skyed byed kyi skor las/ dmar khrid lam lngar khrid par byed pa'i skabs yin/ de la gsum ste/ gang gis 'chad pa'i bla ma/ gang la 'chad pa'i bla ma/ ji ltar 'chad pa'i gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan te/ tshig gi gdams pas sgro 'dogs gcod nus pa/ don gyi ngo sprod kyis rtogs pa bskyed nus pa byin rlabs kyis snang ba bsgyur nus pa/ myong ba'i mtshan nyid kyis gegs sel nus pa ste/ 'di lta bu'i bla ma de thag nye ring dang*/ lus ngal dub dang*/ nor zad 'phangs la mi lta bar btsal la/ rnyed nas gzu lum dang ras chod spangs te/ bsnyen bkur la tshad bzung med pa'i sgo nas lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'bral med du brten par bya'o// de ltar yang*/ sdud pa las/ bla ma mkhas pa rnams ni rtag tu brtan bya ste// ci'i phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni chos sum (355)ldan te/ rgyud dad pa'i rlan dang ma bral ba/ grogs brtson 'grus kyi ngang chags pa/ ngo bo shes rab kyi dbang po rno ba'o// de la dad pa ni chos sgor 'jug pa la med thabs med de/ thar pa'i rten du dad pa dgos/ yon tan gyi gzhi yang dad pas byed/ brtson 'grus kyi grogs kyang dad pas byed/ shes rab kyi mdzod kyang dad pas byed/ man ngag gi snod kyang dad pas byed/ des na dkar po'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa/ yon tan thob phyir chos kyi gdungs pa 'dod pa'i dad pas/ chos byed kyi gang zag la dang pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa zhig dgos te/ mdo las/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// zhes so// de yang dad pas blo chos la song yang*/ brtson 'grus med na chos lam du mi longs pas grogs brtson 'grus kyis zin pa zhig dgos te/

sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis chos la phyi bshol med par 'jug /go cha'i brtson 'grus kyis skyo dub med par mthar skyel/ chog mi shes pa'i brtson 'grus kyis chos la ngoms pa med par slob pa'o// chos lam du longs kyang shes rab med na lam gyi 'khrul pa sel mi nus pas ngo bo shes rab kyi dbang po rno ba zhig dgos te/ thos pa'i shes rab kyis chos spyi'i rnam pa la sgro 'dogs gcod/ bsam shes kyis chos la nges shes bskyed/ sgom pa'i shes rab kyis don rang gi mtshan nyid rtogs nus pa yin no// de ltar yang sdud pa las/ shes rab med na pha rol phyin lnga 'di dag gis// dmigs bu med pas bgrod par nus pa ma yin no// zhes so// gsum pa la lam gyi snod rung du sgrub pa sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi lam lnga'i dmar khrid/ zhar byung nyer mkho'i thabs kyi yan lag gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po la/ spyi'i sngon (356)'gros 'khor ba'i zhen 'khris bcad pa dang*/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gros lam gyi gzhi sgrub cing bsags sbyang byed pa'o// dang po la bzhi las/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa'i khrid ni/ 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ da res dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che thob pa'i skabs 'dir thar ba zhig bya dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan chos sgrub pa'i rten 'di kho na las gzhan med cing*/ 'di ni shin tu rnyed dka' ba u dum+bā ra'i me tog dang 'dra/ rnyed da don che bas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra bas/ chos kyi rten mi lus gtsang ma thob pa'i dus 'dir/ gru yod dus chu bo las brgal dgos pa bzhin du/ da res skye ba gtan gyi so nam bstan pa'i snying po dri ma med pa 'di la 'bad par bya dgos te/ zhi ba lhas/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bus don grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na// phyis ni yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur// zhes dang*/

rje btsun dam pas/ dal 'byor mi lus rin chen gling dang 'dra// mdo med stong log ma byed ding ri ba// zhes so// gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa ni/ sngar bsags kyi dge ba'i las kyis tshe 'dir mtho ris kyi rten phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas skabs cung zad thob tu zin kyang*/ rtag pa ma yin te/ tshe ston ka'i na bun bas yun thung*/ lus chu lbur bas 'jig sla/ longs spyod sgyu ma ltar rtag mi thub/ gnyen 'khor srin bal gyi 'dab ma bas gyes sla ba yin te/ mdo las/ lang tsho rnams ni ri gzar chu ltar 'gro// skad cig skad cig yud tsam shin tu myur// ston ka'i sprin stug snying po med pa dang*// dbyar kha'i chu drag yun du mi gnas ltar// longs spyod mi rtag snying po med par rtogs// zhes gsungs/ des na skyes phan chad tshe thar du lus pa (357)su yang med pas nges par 'chi zhing*/ tshe la long med pas nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba'i tshe zad nor longs spyod gnas lus dbang thang sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang bas/ tshe 'di ltos kyi bya byed la cis kyang dgos pa med/ 'chi ba'i nang par chos min pa gang gis kyang mi stongs pas/ sdar ma'i pang du sbrul zhugs pa'am/ sgeg mo'i mgo la me shor ba ltar/ da lta nyid nas dam chos la brtson 'grus drag pos 'bad dgos te/ dam pas/ yengs pa'i bar la 'chi bdag bdud kyis 'dzin// da lta nyid du sgrubs shig ding ri ba// zhes so// gsum pa rgyu 'bras la bsam pa ni/ de ltar shi nas kyang gtan med du mi 'gro ste/ dge sdig gnyis po ni lus dang grib ma bzhin du nges par rjes su 'brang*/ sdig pa byas zin pa skyur dbang ni med/ dge ba rang gis ma byas pa khyer rgyu ni med/ mi dge ba'i las kyis ngan song du ltung na ci tsug byed/ der mi skye ba'i gding ni med/ gal te mtho ris su skyes su zin kyang der yang sdug bsngal gyi cha thams cad mi dge bas bskyed par 'dug

/des na deng phyin chad sdig pa srog la babs kyang mi byed/ dge ba'i las phra mo khyad du mi gsod/ rlabs po che'i dge ba la dpa' mi zhums par/ lus ngag yid gsum bar mtshams med par dge ba'i las la 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar slob dgos pas dge sdig la spang len nan tan bya'o// snyam du zhe dam 'cha' ste/ dam pas/ las kyi rnam smin rgyu 'bras bden par nges// mi dge sdig la 'dzems shig ding ri ba// zhes so// bzhi pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la bsam pa ni/ rang cag rnams las kyi dbang gis 'khor ba'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs nam (358)yang med de/ lus ngag yid gsum 'dod pa'i nad kyis gdungs/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i lcags sgrog gis bcings/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi drwa bar tshud/ 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang skyed med de/ dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwangs bkres skoms kyi sdug bsngal/ byol song gi gnas na glen lkugs dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal/ bde 'gro lha mi'i gnas thob kyang sdug bsngal gyi mtha' las ma 'das te/ 'khor ba ni zug gzer rgyun mi chad pa'i nang pa'am nag can btson dong du tshud pa dang 'dra bas/ da res chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen tshang ba'i skabs 'dir 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i gnas las nges par thar ba zhig bya dgos te/ rje dam pas/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam na snying rlung ldang*// 'di la gad mo mi bro ding ri ba/ zhes so// de ltar bsam bya rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas tshe 'di'i che thabs la blo log par gyur na bzod thar lam rnal ma zhig rgyud la skye ba yin no// gnyis pa la lnga ste/ theg pa spyi'i rmangs rdo skyabs 'gro/ theg chen gyi rmangs rdo sems bskyed/ mthun rkyen tshogs gsog maṇ+ḍal/ 'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong byed yig brgya'i sgom bzlas/ rgyud grol bar byed pa'i thabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/

thog mar lam thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs 'gro'i khrid 'di gal che ste/ lam nyams su len pa'i dus su yang skyabs 'gro byas pas lam gyi bar chad sel/ bslab pa len pa'i dus su'ang skyabs 'gro byas pas bslab pa'i gzhi 'dzin/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dus su'ang skyabs 'gro byas pas theg pa chen po'i blo khyad par can du byed/ dbang bskur zhu ba'i dus su'ang skyabs 'gro byas pas tha mal gyi rgyud smin/ phyi nang gi 'jigs pa byung na'ang skyabs 'gro byas pas 'jigs pa thams cad sel/ des na/ rje dam (359)pas/ blo snying brang gsum dkon mchog phyogs su gtod// byin rlabs 'byung bar nges kyis ding ri ba/ zhes phan yon dpag tu med pa gsungs pa'i phyir dus rtag tu dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba gal che bas/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad ka'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rnam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i cha lugs can du bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin phung gtibs pa lta bur bzhugs par mos nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad ra ltes ling skyur gyis skyabs 'gro byed par mos la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// zhes ci nus bzlas mthar 'khor rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la bsdus/ de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas thim pa'i ngang la ci gnas bzhag go// gnyis pa ni/ thog mar byams snying rje sgom dgos te/ rje dam pas/ 'gro drug sems can drin can pha ma yin// byams dang snying rje sgoms shig ding ri ba// zhes gsungs pa ltar dang po rang gis tshe 'di'i pha mas drin gdags tshul la bsam/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad rang gi pha ma ma gyur pa med pas/

de thams cad kyis pha ma lan grangs dpag med byas nas/ de ltar phan btags pa sha stag yin pa la 'di rnams bde ba dang skyid pa kho na 'dod kyang thabs mi mkhas pas rtag tu sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bar ma zad/ da dung sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la 'jug pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ 'o na snying rje ba'i sar bzhag pas mi phan/ 'di thams cad sdug bsngal gyi gnas nas bdag kho nas drangs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i (360)ched du bdag gis 'gro kun sgrol nus pa'i go 'phang sgrub par bgyi'o snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam la/ shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bgyis nas// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyi// zhes lhag bsam drag pos ci nus sgom nas/ mthar yul sems can mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa la gnyis las/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ rgyu gser dngul lta bu rin po che mchog yin na sor bzhi las mi chung ba dang*/ 'khar ba lta bu rin po che phal pa yin na mtho gang las mi chung ba'i maṇ+ḍal mtshan nyid ldan pa dri bzang gi chus chag chag gdab/ maṇ+ḍal g.yas pas bzung la g.yon pas nang bskor du phyi bzhin du oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas maṇ+ḍal de rin po che'i 'byung gnas rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ de ma thag de nyid dang ma bral bzhin du maṇ+ḍal gyi mthar srin lag gis reg cing*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes pas srung 'khor sgom/ de nas oṃ na mo rat+na gu ru āḥhūm̐ zhes maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su tshom bu gcig /oṃ na mo rat+na tra yā ya āḥhūm̐ zhes mdun du gcig /oṃ na mo ma hā shrī he ru kā ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes g.yas su gcig /oṃ na mo badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhūm̐/ zhes rgyab tu gcig /oṃ na mo dharma pā la āḥhūm̐/ zhes g.yon du tshom bu gcig rnams bkod pas lnga ka'i gnas su pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab ma rgyas pa yangs shing mdzes pa re rer gyur pa las/

dbus kyi pad sdong gi steng du seng khri pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs pa'i mthar mos gus kyi gnas su gyur pa'i bla ma thams cad bzhugs par bsam/ de bzhin du mdun steng seng khri yangs par ston pa thub dbang la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba dang*/ (361)chos dkon mchog pu sti brtsegs pa'i rnam pa/ dge 'dun dkon mchog byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang rnams bzhugs pa/ g.yas kyi ri rab chu skyes nyi zla 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan khar bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum la rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ rgyab kyi steng chos 'byung bsnol ma mi ro'i gdan khar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la las dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba/ g.yon steng dgra bgegs kyi gdan gyi steng du ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra lcam dral la dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs chos skyong srung mas bskor ba rnams bzhugs pa/ slar yang g.yon du sur+yā ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes tshom bu gcig bkod pa nyi gdan dang*/ g.yas su oṃ na mo a tsan+d+ra ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes tshom bu gcig bkod pa zla ba'i gdan yangs pa gnyis kyi steng du phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad sgrub pa po thams cad bzhugs par bsam la/ maṇ+ḍal de nyid mdun du btegs la bkod de/ de'i mdun mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ rgyas pa la tshom bu nyer gsum/ 'bring la bcu gcig /bsdus pa la bdun bshad pa las/ da lta bsdus pa phyag len du mdzad pa ltar na/ rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal la dris chag chag btab la sngags gnyis kyis 'phyi ba dang srung 'khor sgom pa sngar ltar byas rjes/ dbus su ri rab/ phyogs bzhir gling bzhi/ shar nub gnyis kyi nang du nyi zla'i tshom bu ste bdun bkod la ngag tu/ rin chen ri rab gser ri rol mtshos brgyan// shar gling lus 'phags bum pa bzang pos mdzes// sgra mi snyan gling dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*// ba lang spyod ni 'dod 'jo'i bas brgyan cing*// 'dzam gling yid bzhin nor bus legs par brgyan// gsal byed nyi zla zung zhig bskor ba byed// bar (362)mtshams thams cad rin chen bdun la sogs// lha klu mi yi mchod rdzas kyis bkang bas// bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/
