zhes snod bcud kyi zhing khams lus longs spyod dang bcas pa phul bas/ de'i tshe steng nas lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab/ 'og nas klu rnams kyis rin po che'i dbyig phul/ bar nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis phyi nyer spyod lnga/ nang 'dod yon lnga/ gsang ba bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i mchod sprin dpag tu med pa phul bar bsam zhing*/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal ci nus dbul nas mthar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dad cing gus pas pus btsug thal mo sbyar te/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa bskyed du gsol/ zhen 'khris med pa'i phan sems dang snying rje chen po rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ dag pa'i snang ba sna tshogs 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ ces lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi rten de rnams tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas sib kyis thim par bsam zhing*/ lag g.yon gyi zla ba'i tshom bu nas mas yar rim pas bsdus pa thal mo'i bar du bzung nas snying gar bcangs pas tshogs zhing rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ yon tan phrin las byed pa dang bcas pa bdag rgyud la brtan par bsam la bsngo smon bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ rang lus tha mal du*/ (363)gnas pa'i spyi bor sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bla ma dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum la mtshan dpe'i long tsho rgyas pa g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar dkar po gser gyi dang ris can gyi stod g.yogs dang*/ dar khra'i sham thabs sogs dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa'i/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong rang gi tshangs bug tu reg gi bzhugs par bsam la/

dam tshig nyams chags sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams la 'gyod sdom drag pos yig brgya gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzlas pas/ rdor sems kyi thugs kar dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs tshad med pa'i rang bzhin hūm̐ yig dkar po las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dngul chu 'dril ba ltar dkar nang gyis byung ba zhabs g.yas pa'i lam nas brgyud mthe bong las babs pa rang gi spyi bo nas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad du dkar 'du ru ru dkar sham sham babs pas bdag rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bshang lam dang chu lam rkang sen gyi bar sogs nas nag nyil nyil thon te rang lus shel sgong phyis pa ltar gtsang sing gis song*/ mthar rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyong mkhan thams cad rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la skyur te mnyam par bzhag la bsngo ba bya'o// lnga pa ni/ rang rgyud grol bar byed pa'i bdag rkyen bla ma dam pa kho na la brten dgos te/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyang dang po lam nyams su len pa'i thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas blang dor shes pa la 'jug dgos shing*/ bar du lam gyi dngos gzhi nyams su len pa yang (364)bla ma la rags lus pa'i phyir/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson pas slob pa gal che ste/ bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba dang rtogs pa rgyud la shar ba dus mnyam par gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sa// de ltar yang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs brten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ rang gi rig pa ye shes ni// tshig gi lam 'das spyod yul nyid// 'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir// zhes so// de la bla ma'i phyag bzhes su/ rten 'brel gyi ston du rten 'brel gyi bdag po gtong bya bya yin gsungs nas/ 'dir dam pa phyi sgrub dang sbyar nas mdzad pa la'ang 'gal ba med mod kyi/

'on kyang 'dir glegs bam las 'byung ba ltar sngon 'gro chos gsum gyi nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyid sbyar ba 'brel bas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bo'i thad kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che 'od 'bar ba'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan yangs pa la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sku mtshan dpes spras shing zhal gzi mdangs dang ldan pa/ thugs bdag la dgyes pa'i tshul gyi byin gyis brlabs/ cha lugs sprul sku rab byung gi chas sam/ longs sku 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba'i chas sam/ chos sku cha lugs kyi 'dzin pa med pa gcer bu nam mkha'i gos can rnams gang mos kyi rnam par bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du/ mos gus byed tshad kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag med sprin phung gtibs pa lta bu/ sku las tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi 'od zer dkar pos 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par bsam mo// de nas sems can thams cad kyi byang rang gis drangs te/ (365)thams cad kyang lus zhing gi rdul rnyed du sprul te phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ phyi nyer spyod/ nang 'dod yon/ gsang ba bdud rtsi lnga/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pas mchod pa dang*/ sdig sgrib 'gyod sdom gyi bshags pa dang*/ rmad byung gi mdzad pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bla na med pa'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ dge rtsa bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba rnams tshig ji ltar rigs pa 'bul ba sngon du btang nas/ lus gus pas zhabs la btud cing gdung shugs kyi mchi ma 'brul/ ngag snyan pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so// de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa myur du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs shig /bla ma sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so// snang ba thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs shig

/bla ma sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so// gzhan don rlabs po che 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /ces ci nus dang*/ spro na/ gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du/ zhes sogs brgyud 'debs kyang 'don/ yid gus pas ci mdzad khyed shes kyi re ltos bkal nas gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas gsol ba btab na byin rlabs btsan thabs su 'jug pa yin no// mjug tu bla ma'i spyi mgrin snying ga'i gnas gsum nas tshad med thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer dkar dmar sngo gsum gyi rnam par 'phros/ rang dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi mgrin snying ga'i gnas gsum dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas thim pas lus nang thams cad 'od des mer gyis khengs pa bde ba chen po'i ye shes su phril gyis (366)gyur bar bsam/ mtha' bskor gyi bla ma dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams yud kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de rang gi spyi bor byon nas bzhugs par bsam la/ spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du yengs pa med pa'i mos gus dung dung pa bya'o// de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'bad na/ rtogs pa'i ye shes ma skyes pa bskyed/ skyes pa 'phel/ 'phel ba mthar phyin pa sogs yon tan dpag med 'byung bas lam gyi nang bas mchog tu gyur pa'i myur lam yang dag pa yin no// thun bsdu ba thams cad kyi mjug tu dam pa'i smon lam sum cu ma'am/ kun dga'i smon lam bcu gsum ma/ yang na smon lam ye shes nor bu zhes rdo rje'i tshig drug ma 'di 'don te/ na mo bdag dang bdag gi rigs bdag la sogs pa// mtha' yas rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i 'gro ba rnams// 'di nas tshe 'phos rin chen can gyi zhing*// byang sems smon lam grub pas dkrigs pa'i nang*// rgyan gyi 'khor lo pho brang rnam mdzes pa// yongs bdag gzhal med khang du skye bar shog

/ces kyang brjod do// lam gyi snod rung du grub pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos rnams yig rnying gi don ltar bkod pa yin no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi lam lnga'i dmar khrid bshad pa la gsum ste/ bya ba gzhi'i rnal 'byor/ byed pa lam gyi rnal 'byor/ bya bral 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ rten sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing rnal 'byor gyi rang sa drug ma nyams par bsrung ba'o// de la sdom pa gsum ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi kha na ma tho ba'i sdig pa phra zhing phra ba nas 'dzem pa nyan thos kyi 'dul khrims/ sems can gyi don la chog mi shes par 'jug pa byang sems kyi bslab pa/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su bltas nas ci gsung gi bka' sgrub pa gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ste (367)gzhis nyan thos kyi 'dul khrims dam pa/ nang byang sems kyi sdom pa yangs pa/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gtsang ma zhes kyang bya'o// de ltar yang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ so so thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o// zhes so// rnal 'byor gyi rang sa drug bsrung ba ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lha la gsol ba mi 'debs te/ kun btags yin pas bslu zhing rdzun pa nyid kyis blo phug mi thub pa'i phyir ro// des na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma las re ltos gzhan du mi 'tshol lo// dngos grub 'dre la mi zhu ste/ rnal 'byor bdag gis 'byung po sgrub pa'i 'du langs bar chad kyi g.yab mos thar lam la gnod de/ zho lam dar bas 'gags pa ltar ro// des na nyams len pa lto gos la gyong khur te 'tsho ba gyi na la brten cing nyams len mthar dbyung ngo*// pho sgo tshe 'dir mi 'byin te/ tshe 'di'i che thabs thams cad nam bzhag gtan gyi chung thabs su 'dug pas/ 'di bas phyi ma shul thag ring ba'i phyir 'jig rten gyi che thabs dang*/ 'dun ma mi sgrub par dman sa bzung nas thar lam kho na btsal bar bya'o// sna thag mi la mi gtad de/

bya ba ngo dgar shor na chos kyi dgos pa 'chor bas/ rang zhe nas chos byed pa'i rang dbang rang gis thob par bya'o// gsang ba mchu sgor mi 'don te/ rang la shar ba'i nyams rtogs gzhan la bshad na nyams rtogs kyi 'phel ba chad 'gro bas/ yon tan gsang zhing spel bar bya'o// ngo so rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la mi 'phyar te/ mis mthong khyis tshor gyi nyams len mngon mtshan can la bar chad kyi bdud 'byung bas gsang spyod kyi sgo nas mthar phyin par bya'o// de yang rgyal po zla ba 'od zer gyi zhal nas/ rnal (368)'byor gyi rang sa ma nyams pa chos min yid la mi 'gyu bar byed/ log pa'i shes pa tshar gcod pa'i gnad yin/ zhes bstan to// 'dir rang sa'i dri ma bzhi yang shis par bya ste/ chos brgyad kyi ngad chags na bo ba'i dri ma yin pas chos brgyad mgo snyoms par bya/ spyod lam 'jig rten pa dang bstun na/ zags pas rang tshugs thub par bya/ 'khor bar blo ma log na ltems pas/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal du bsam/ 'khor bar yid ma log na log pas mi rtag par shes pas gtan 'dun bsgrub par bya'o// gnyis pa byed pa lam gyi rnal 'byor la/ dngos dang de dka' thub gsum gyi bsrang nas 'don pa'o// dang po byed pa lam gyi rnal 'byor dngos la lnga ste/ tshogs lam blo spyod/ sbyor lam dka' thub/ mthong lam rjes/ sgom lam ro snyoms/ mthar lam bya bral lo// dang po tshogs lam blo sbyong la gsum ste/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi rgyud la dbang bskur lugs/ rjes lam gyi tshar tshad bslab bya dang bcas pa'o// dang po la/ rten bskyed pa/ tshogs bsags pa/ lam brtan pa dang gsum/ dang po la rten rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ rten rgyas par bskyed pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma'i sdong po yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab ma kha bye ba yongs su rgyas pa'i nang du seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la/

dngos kyi bla ma sku mtshan dpe dang ldan pa/ zhal gzi mdangs dang ldan pa/ thugs bdag kho na la dgyes pas rjes su 'dzin pa zhig bzhugs par bsam mo// de'i dbu'i steng du pad+ma'i sdong bu gcig dril gyi steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma drug brtsegs la mas nas rim bzhin mkhas grub (369)blo gros brtan pa/ mtshungs med bkra shis bzang po/ khyab bdag dpal 'byor phun tshogs/ 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor lhun grub/ mkhas grub nam mkha' bzang po/ sku gsum bde chen lhun grub/ de'i dbu'i steng du sdong bu gnyis su gyis pa'i bla ma gsum brtsegs kyi byang sems rgya mtsho sbyin pa/ rgya sgom rdo rje gdan pa/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dpal bzang*/ sdong bu gcig shos la bla ma bzhi brtsegs kyi snye nang lung chen pa bsod nams dpal bzang*/ thugs sras bsod nams 'od zer/ ras chen dpal ldan bsod nams/ chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho/ de gnyis kyi dbu'i steng pad sdong gcig tu dril bar/ kun mkhyen byang chub bzang po/ de yi steng sdong bu gnyis su gyes pa'i gcig la rgya ston smon lam shes rab/ gcig shos la drin can sangs rgyas dbon/ mkhan chen tshul khrims phan/ mtshan ldan ri khrod dbang phyug rnams gsum brtsegs su bzhugs pa/ rgya ston dang mtshan ldan pa'i dbu'i steng du sdong po gnyis gyes la rog rgyal sras kun dga' bzang po dang kun dga' don grub sku mched/ de gnyis kyi dbu steng sdong bu gcig tu dril ba la rog thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams dpal/ de'i dbu steng pad sdong rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i 'dab ma la rog shes 'od/ zhig po nyi ma seng ge /snye mdo smra ba'i seṅge ste sku mched rin po che rnam pa gsum gral 'phrad du bkrig gi bzhugs pa/ de dag gi dbu'i steng pad+ma'i sdong bu gcig tu 'dril ba'i steng du bla ma bzhi brtsegs la grub thob rgyal ba te ne/ mkhas btsun spa tshab sgom pa/

skye med byang sems kun dga'/ rje btsun dam pa rgya gar rin po che sku mdog smug la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ dbu skra yo (370)'bog gi sdong po ltar gzengs pa/ sku la ras khra bo'i ang rag gsol ba/ snang srid thams cad mnan na non pa/ btegs na theg pa/ phyag rgya rtsa bsnol du bzhugs par bsam mo// de dag gi dbu'i steng du pad+ma'i sdong bu yal 'dab lnga bcu rtsa bzhir gyur pa la thun mong mi'i bla ma grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi ste/ mdun du sa ra ha sogs phyag rgya chen po brda'i bla ma bcu gcig /g.yas su sangs rgyas gsang ba

pad+ma badz+ra/ ngag gi dbang phyug /go dha ri/ karma badz+ra/ dza ba ti/ ye shes zhabs/ klu byang*/ swa nan+tā/ kriṣ+ṇa ba/ ba su dha ri rnams so/ sogs// pha brgyud g.yo ba rlung gi bla ma bcu gcig tsār+ya pa/ gu ṇa ti/ tog tse pa/ ko ṣa pa/ sha ba ta/ mai tri pa/ phā ga ra sid+dhi/ nyi ma sbas pa/ ā ka ra sid+dhi/ rat+na badz+ra rnams so/ /g.yon du mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ ḍom+bhi pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ ti li pa/ nag po zhabs/ sgeg pa rdo rje/ lū i pa/ bi rū pa/ kun snying*/ ku ku ra pa rnams so/ /ma rgyud bde ba nyams kyi bla ma bcu gcig /rgyab tu klu sgrub snying po shes rab bzang po/ yon tan 'od/ chos grags/ ā ka ri sid+dhi/ shaṅka ra/ ye shes snying po/ thogs med/ ār+ya de ba/ zhi ba lha/ gser gling pa rnams so/ /sogs mtshan nyid sgra dang rig pa'i bla ma bcu gcig /mtshams rnams su ḍā ki su kha sid+dhi/ ri khrod ma/ pad+mo zhabs/ ku mu da/ bde ba'i 'byung gnas/ gaṅgā bzang mo/ tsi to ma/ lak+ṣi ma/ shing lo ma rnams so/ /sogs mkha' 'gro ma rig pa ngo sprod kyi bla ma bcu'o// de dag gi steng du pad+ma'i sdong bu yal 'dab sum cu rtsa drug tu gyur pa la/ ngo mtshar mkha' spyod kyi bla ma dpal ldan sum cu rtsa drug ste/ de yang rang sa ston pa'i rgyal po drug /blo sbyong ston pa'i btsun mo drug /dka' thub ston pa'i drang srong drug /rjes ston pa'i bram ze drug /ro snyoms ston pa'i khyim bdag drug /bdag (371)gtod ston pa'i ded dpon drug rnams so// de dag gi dbu'i steng du pad sdong yal 'dab nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur pa bal/ byin rlabs mkha' 'gro ma'i bla ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ de yang sa 'og spyod pa sku'i mkha' 'gro dkar mo brgyad/ sa steng spyod pa gsung gi mkha' 'gro dmar mo brgyad/ bar snang spyod pa thugs kyi mkha' 'gro sngon mo brgyad po thams cad kyang gri thod kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa'o// de dag gi dbu'i steng du pad 'dab bcu gnyis su gyur pa la/

'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor/ sgrol ma/ kha sār+pa ṇi/ gshin rje gshed/ rang byung rgyal mo// sgrib sel/ 'od zer can ma/ kun bzang*/ phag mo// mi g.yo ba ste thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi bla ma bcu gnyis/ de dag gi dbu'i steng du pad 'dab bzhir gyur pa bal sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i bla ma ste/ de yang chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen yum bdag med ma dang zhal sbyor du bzhugs pa/ longs sku rnam par snang mdzad/ sprul sku shākya thub pa/ ngo bo nyid sku gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje rnams bzhugs par bsam mo// rten 'bring du bskyed na/ dngos kyi bla ma rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba'i bar sngar ltar las/ dam pa'i dbu thog tu bdag med ma bsgom pa'o// rten bsdus par bsgom na/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig pu bsgom pas chog ste/ de ni dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams dang dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus yin pa'i phyir ro// de yang byin rlabs kyi tshan chung nyams kyi bogs chung*/ dngos kyi bla ma la yid ches shas chung na rten rgyas pa'i lugs sgom/ yang byin rlabs tshan che/ dngos kyi bla ma la yid rab tu ches na bsdus pa'i lugs su sgom/ de dag ci rigs pa la 'bring du bskyed pa'i lugs su (372)sgom mo// gang ltar yang 'dir bla ma chos skur sgrub pa'i skabs yin pas rgyan gyi spros pa med pa gcer bu nam mkha'i chos gos can no// gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa la gsum las/ dang po maṇ+ḍal gyi sgo nas tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bzhi pa zhig bshams pa de nyid rin po che sna tshogs pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i rgya mtsho dwangs pa'i dbus ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla mtha' 'khor yug dang bcas pa lha mi'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang bar dmigs te/ oṃ na mo gu ru maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes lan lnga'am gsum gyis 'bul lo// gnyis pa rang lus kyi sgo nas tshogs bsags pa ni/

rang gi spyi bor yi ge traṃ ser po gnas pa zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i phung po bla ma la mkho ba'i yo byad 'dod rgu sna tshogs pa'i 'byung gnas su bsam ste/ oṃ na mo gu ru trāṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul lo// gsum pa sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas tshogs bsag pa ni/ bdag gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse mo las 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pa byung nas mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyi sprin spro bar bsam ste/ oṃ na ro gu ru sarba maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul bas dgyes mnyes tshim par bsam mo// gsum pa lam brten pa ni/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yang bla ma dam pa rnams la mos pa dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yi dam lha tshogs rnams (373)la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yang yi dam lha tshogs rnams la mos pa dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams la mos pa dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus te bla ma la dbul bar bgyi'o// bla ma la phul bas bla ma rin po che rnams kyi thugs dgongs khyad par can yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig

/de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan lam du mchod pa'i bye brag nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'byung bar gyur cig /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bsngo bar bgyi'o// de ltar bsngos pas sems can thams cad 'khor ba srid pa sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar yang bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba ma lus pa mtha' dag gi bla ma byed par gyur cig /de kho na bzhin du grub par gyur cig /ces mchog tu gyur pa'i skyabs 'gro/ bla na med pa'i sems bskyed/ ngo mtshar can gyi mchod pa/ sems can dang mi phyed pa'i bsngo ba/ (374)gzhan don du 'gyur nges kyi smon lam dang lnga po 'di lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun sogs mdor na rang rgyud la drod chil gyis ma babs kyi bar du bya ste/ rgyal po stobs ldan snying po'i zhal nas/ skyabs gnas kyi yul bcud la bor bas/ rgyud la dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par byed/ byin rlabs brgyud pa'i gnad gong nas gong du spor cig /ces gsungs so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi rgyud la dbang bskur lugs la/ grags pa sgra'i brjod tshul yi ge lam khyer/ dbang bzhi dmigs pa'i khyad par 'khor lo bzhi'i sgom thabs/ rtsa ba ngo sprod kyi khyad par mnyam rjes gnyis kyi lag len/ rjes gnang lung gi khyad par bla ma'i thugs dam bskul lugs so// dang po ni/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa tha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥzhes lan bzhi brjod pa'i dang po mig yul du snang tshad kyi gzugs thams cad rnam pa yi ge la ngo bo bla ma'i skur bsam/ gnyis pa rna bar grag tshad kyi sgra thams cad rnam pa yi ge la ngo bo bla ma'i gsung*/

gsum pa dran rtog yid la ci 'gyus thams cad rnam pa yi ge la ngo bo bla ma'i thugs/ bzhi pa snang grag 'gyu gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su shar ba de thams cad kyang rang gi sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal tsam du shes par bya'o// des ni ched du dran pa rgyun chags su brten mi dgos par gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod kun thems nas yul la dag snang phyogs med du 'byongs par 'gyur te/ btsun mo lha dpal 'od zer gyi zhal nas/ ngag nas bre mo'i gtam brjod pas sngags kyi bzlas brjod thems par byed/ ā (375)li kā li gnad 'di ltar ro// zhes bstan to// gnyis pa dbang bzhi dmigs pa'i khyad par 'khor lo bzhi'i sgom thabs ni/ rang gi spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar bla ma'i sku'i sa bon oṃ yig dkar po bsam ste/ a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ oṃ las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun dkar nar gyis babs pas lus kyi nang kun dkar mer gyis khengs par bsam mo// mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar bla ma'i gsung gi sa bon āḥyig dmar po/ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes pas āḥ las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun dmar po lhug lhug babs pas lus kyi nang thams cad dmar mer mar gyis khengs par bsam mo// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar bla ma'i thugs kyi sa bon hūm̐ yig sngon po/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes pas hūm̐ las byang sems kyi chu rgyun sngo phreng gis byung bas rdo rje lus kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams bskul te/ de rnams gnyis su med par sbyor ba mdzad pas lus thams cad zag med kyi bde bas gang bar bsam mo// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su rin po che zur brgyad pa'i lte bar bla ma'i yon tan gyi sa bon hrīḥ

ser po/ a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes pas hrīḥlas byang sems kyi chu rgyun kha dog sna tshogs pa byung bas lus sems snang ba'i dngos po thams cad mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar yal nas stong rjen gyis song bar bsam mo// des ni lus kyi chos byang sems rtsa rlung dang bcas pa steng 'og gi sgo la ma brten par las su rung bar 'gyur te// btsun mo ye shes 'od zer gyi zhal nas/ ring lam 'khor los bstungs pas rten smin par byed pa dbang bzhi lam khyer (376)blo sbyong gi gnad 'di ltar ro// zhes bstan to// gsum pa rtsa ba ngo sprod kyi khyad par mnyam rjes kyi lag len la gnyis las/ dang po mnyam bzhag la ngo sprad pa na/ 'khrul 'khor gsum la brten nas sems kyi ngo bo ngos 'dzin te/ de la lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ rnam snang gi chos bdun bca' ste/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung bya/ lag mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bca'/ sgal tshigs drang po bsrangs/ mgrin pa yid tsam rgu/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyang*/ lce ya rkan la sbyar zhing mchu dang so rang lugs su bzhag /lta stangs rdzi ma mi 'thab cing mig 'bras mi 'gul bar sna rtse la phab ste bzhag go /de yang rgyal sras dri med grags pa zla ba seng ge'i zhal nas/ rten 'brel lus la sgrigs pa'i che bas nyams myong sems la 'char bar byed pa 'khrul 'khor 'dug stangs kyi gnad 'di ltar ro// zhes so// ngag gi 'khrul 'khor ni/ rtsol med byang chub sems kyi rlung bzung ba zhes bya ste/ rtsol sgrub med par dbugs so mar bzhag go /sems kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ yid mig sna rtse gsum gcig tu sgril te/ sems bzang rtog ngan rtog gang gis kyang ma bslad par rang lugs su rtsen gyis 'jog tu bcug /de ltar bzhag pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rang gi ngo bo de rang lugs su gnas shes pa 'byung ste/ btsun mo lha mo dpal gyi seng ge'i zhal nas/

ngo bo sbal pa gser gyi nyi ma'i 'od phye bas/ rtogs pa'i ye shes phyogs med du 'char bar byed/ phyag rgya chen po brda'i gnad rig par gyis shig /ces gdams so// de yang tha mal gyi shes pa gdod nas stong pa de ngo shes pa'i phyir rtsen gyis 'jog /de la gnas su ma gtub cing stong pa de ngos ma zin na rtog pa de nyid lhod kyis glod du (377)gzhug ste/ do ha las/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces so// gal te stong pa dngos zin na gsal bdo ba la shigs kyis bshig cing bsgoms pas rjes je bzang du 'gro ba yin te/ ded dpon dpal gyi snying po'i zhal nas/ mnyam bzhag gsal ba'i gdangs la bshig pas gnas pa'i phyir rjes bzang bar byed pas thun thung la grangs mang bas byings rgod kyis mi zin pa'i gnad yin no// zhes gsungs so// de ltar thun che chung dang grangs mang nyung khams tshod dang bstun cing*/ bying rgod kyi dbang du mi btang bar sgrims glod re mos su nyams su blangs pas rtog pa rtsa bral du go nas gsal la mi rtog pa'i ye shes la gnas pa 'byung na ngo sprad par bya ste/ de la gsum/ ngo bo stong pa la ngo sprad pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba la gnas shes pa/ mtshan nyid 'phro ba la grol shes pa'o// dang po ngo bo stong pa la ngo sprad pa ni/ 'khrul 'khor gsum gyis shes pa rten med du 'jog tu bcug la/ ngo sprod tshul la gsum las phyi'i sgro 'dogs bcad pa ni/ phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di dag ji ltar snang ji ltar gsal kyang phyi rol na bden par grub pa med de/ rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba rmi lam gyi ltad mo lta bu'o// mdo las/ 'di dag rnam par rig tsam nyid// yod pa ma yin don snang phyir// dper na rab rib can dag gis// skra zla la sogs med snang bzhin// zhes so// nang gi sgro 'dogs bcad pa ni// snang ba rang sems kyi 'khrul snang yin na/

sems de rang ji lta bu zhig yod snyam na/ sems kyis sems la bltas pas/ sems de la skye ba'i rgyu med/ gnas pa'i gzhi med/ rang gi ngo bo cing yang ma grub pa nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu'o// yum las/ sems la sems (378)ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o// zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ chos rnams rang gi sems su blos rtogs nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// ces so// bar gyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa ni/ snang ba rang sems kyi 'khrul snang dang*/ sems nyid cir yang ma grub pa'i stong nyid yin na/ de la dran rig sna tshogs 'gyu ba 'di ci yin snyam na/ 'di stong pa'i rang rtsal 'gags med shar ba bar snang gi rlung ngam/ chu'i lbu ba lta bu zhig yin te/ dang po byung sa med/ tha mar 'gro sa med/ bar du gnas sa med/ rang gi ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa rtsal cir yang ma 'gags par 'char ba zhig yin te/ do ha las/ gang zhig sems las rnam 'phros pas// de ni mgon po'i rang bzhin te// chu dang chu rlabs gzhan yin nam// zhes so// gnyis pa rang bzhin gsal ba la gnas shes pa ni/ sngar sgro 'dogs chod don la gnas shing goms par byed pa yin te/ cer gyis bltas la cir yang ma grub pa'i ngang la bzhag /lhod kyis glod la rtsol sgrub med pa'i don la bzhag /shigs kyis bshig la bya rtsol med pa'i gshis la bzhag /de ltar bzhag pas nyams gsum 'char te/ yul rjes mi 'breng rtog pa dang bral ba/ nyams la ma zhen 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ bsam du med de sgom pa dang bral ba'i nyams 'char ro// gsum pa mtshan nyid 'phro ba la grol shes pa ni/ de ltar bzhag pa'i ngang las rnam rtog 'phro na/ ji ltar bya snyam na/ de'i tshe rtog pa spangs mi dgos te/ rtog pa de nyid la cher gyis bltas pas/ cir yang grub pa med de/ chu'i rlabs sam/ bar snang dngas pa'i rlung bzhin/ 'gyu ba rang shar sangs/ cer mthong cer grol du 'gro bas/

de'i ngang las ma g.yos par mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa rjes thob la ngo sprad pa ni/ mnyam bzhag las langs (379)nas spyod lam byed pa'i tshe/ gzugs su snang tshad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang stong zhen bral du lhag ge ba/ sgra grags tshad se gol gyi sgra'am brag cha ltar grag stong du wang nge ba/ sems kyi dran rtog thams cad rmi lam gyi ltas ltad mo gang la'ang bden zhen med par rjen ne ba rig stong du ngo sprod do// de ltar chos thams cad bden zhen zad phyin chad/ yul la brten nas skye ba'i kun 'byung dug gsum gyi las mi sog cing*/ lus ngag yid gsum ched du bcos pa med par tha mal ltar 'dug kyang tshogs gnyis ngang gis rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin te/ ded dpon nam mkha'i snying po'i zhal nas/ sgo gsum tha mal du sdad pas rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed/ skam thag chu nang nas chod pa bya log gi gnad 'di ltos shig /ces bstan to// bzhi pa rjes gnang lung gi khyad par bla ma'i thugs dam bskul lugs ni/ rang gi spyi bo'i steng du rten rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang mos bskyed pa'i dngos kyi bla ma'i gnas bzhir/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥrnams gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes blo sbyong gi snying po 'bru brgyad pa 'di bdag nyid kyi spyi bo'i bla ma la mos gus gdung shugs drag po dang bcas pas bgrang zhing gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin du rten rgyas 'bring gnyis bskyed pa ltar na/ bla ma 'og ma 'og mas gong ma gong ma la rim gyis mos gus gdung shugs bcam pas snying po 'dren cing bdag gi grogs mdzad de gsol ba mas btab kyi tshul du 'debs par bsam mo// de nas byin rlabs yas zhus tshul du gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma gong ma rnams kyi tshad med pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs kyi 'od zer du rim par zhu nas 'og ma 'og ma la thim pas dngos kyi bla ma'i (380)bar du byin rlabs zhu bar bya zhing*/

dngos kyi bla ma de 'od du ma zhu bar brgyud pa kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la mos gus gdung shugs drag pos snying po bgrangs pas/ bla ma'i gnas bzhi las tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs chen po'i 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ga sna tshogs pa'i rnam par byung ste/ rang gi gnas bzhir chu la chu bzhag pa ltar thim pas/ sgo gsum cha mnyam dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa dag /sku gsung thugs snang stong grags stong dran stong gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs zhugs nas nyams dang rtogs pa 'ar 'ur du 'bar bar bsam mo// thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ dpal ldan bla ma chos sku'i bdag nyid can 'grub par gyur cig /ces brjod cing*/ spyod lam kun tu spyi bo'i bla ma dran par byas la mos gus dung dung pa bya'o// 'dis ni nyon mongs pa can gyi yid la ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal rdzogs par 'gyur zhing sngags gcig gis don phyogs med du 'grub pa zhes bya ste/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa dang nyams myong ma skyes pa skye bar byed/ skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed/ tshe 'dir rtogs pa dang nyams myong rtags dang yon tan ci yang med kyang bar do na ji lta ba 'grub par 'gyur te/ btsun mo ye shes 'od zer gyi zhal nas/ ring lam 'khor lo brdungs te rten smin pas/ sa lam chig rdzogs su gcod par byed pa/ dbang bzhi lam khyer blo sbyong gi gnad 'di ltar ro// zhes bstan to// gsum pa rjes lam gyi tshar tshad bslab bya dang bcas bshad pa la gnyis te/ dri ma bzhi bsrung ba'i bslab bya bshad pa dang*/ tshar ba'i tshad bzhi bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ bo zags ltems log gi dri ma bzhi bsrung lugs te/ blo sbyong gi dus 'dir bla mar ma gus pa'i blo shor na bo// sems can la byams pa'i blo spangs na zags/ (381)don med pa'i spyod pa bzhi dang bcas pa ma spangs na ltem/ ro ma myong bar stan las 'phag na logs pa'i dri mar shes par byas la bsrung dgos pas/

bo na dgang ste/ bla ma'i yon tan dang bka' drin bsam la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ zags na bsdams te/ sems can la byams snying rje tshad med sgom/ ltem na srang ste/ skyo shas drag pos tshe 'di'i bya ba spangs nas dge sbyor la 'bungs pa 'don/ log na bzung ste/ gdams pa zab mo la nges shes bskyed nas sa sde gzug par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ ngo bo'i tshar tshad/ rtags kyi tshar tshad/ yon tan gyi tshar tshad/ grangs kyi tshar tshad dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ chos thams cad sems su shes pas gang la'ang bden zhen med cing sems kyi ngo bo stong nyid brjod bral du shes pa'i don nang nas 'char ba'o// gnyis pa la rgyu lam 'bras bu'i rtags gsum las/ rgyu sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags ni/ skyugs pa dang*/ 'chugs pa dang*/ lus la rnag khrag zags shing sems can 'thon pa dang*/ gos gsar pa gyon pa dang*/ khrus byas pa/ chu bo las brgal ba sogs 'byung ngo*// lam rlung lnga zin pa'i rtags ni/ gyen rgyu sa rlung zin pas smrig rgyu ltar dkar breng breng pa/ srog 'dzin chu rlung zin pas du ba ltar sngo bun bun pa/ thur sel rlung gi rlung zin pas srin bu me khyer ltar dmar tsig tsig pa/ mnyam gnas me rlung zin pas mar me ltar dmar tal le ba/ khyab byed nam mkha'i rlung zin pas sprin med kyi nam mkha' ltar cir yang thogs pa med pa'i snang ba 'char ro// 'bras bu dag snang shar ba'i rtags ni/ rten gsum mthong ba/ nyi zla rang la shar ba/ mkha' la 'phur ba sogs phal cher rmi lam du 'byung ngo*// gsum pa ni/ yongs su grags (382)pa'i rtags tshogs lam gyi yon tan gso sla zhing dgang sla ba sogs 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa ni/ chu klung chen po'i rgyud las/ gsang ba'i snying po bla ma sgrub pa'i sngags// sa ya gcig gis rig 'dzin gnas su skyol// zhes pas blo sbyong gi snying po 'di grangs bye ba sngon du btang ba'i sa ya gcig dang dus zla ba drug gis 'thems par gsungs so// de ltar tshar tshad bzhi las/

ngo bos thems na tshe 'dir rtags kyis 'chi khar/ grangs kyis bar dor/ yon tan gyi skye ba brgyud nas grol zhes gong ma rnams gsung ba yin no// tshogs lam blo sbyong gi khrid yig go /gnyis pa sbyor lam dka' thub la'ang gsum ste/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi nyams su blangs tshul/ rjes bslab bya tshar tshad dang bcas pa'o// dang po la'ang gsum las/ rten bskyed pa ni/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang bskyed kyang longs sku dag pa'i mtshan dpe dang*/ cha lugs phun sum tshogs pa 'ba' zhig tu bskyed par bya ste/ 'dir bla ma longs sku sgrub pa'i dus yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa dang*/ gsum pa lam brten pa sngar dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ dang po grags pa sgra'i brjod tshul yi ge lam khyer ni/ dbyangs gsal lan bzhi brjod pa'i/ dang po gzugs su snang tshad rnam pa yi dam gyi lha rigs lnga'i sku la ngo bo bla ma'i sku/ gnyis pa sgrar grags tshad rnam pa sngags kyi rang sgra'am snying po 'ba' zhig pa la ngo bo bla ma'i gsung*/ gsum pa yid la 'gyu tshad rnam pa mngon shes dang ye shes la ngo bo bla ma'i thugs/ bzhi pa de thams cad kyang rang sems kyi 'char lugs tsam du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa dbang bzhi dmigs pa'i khyad par 'khor lo bzhi'i sgom thabs ni/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i dbus su bla ma'i sku'i sa bon oṃ yig dkar po/ a bhi ṣiñca a (383)zhes pas oṃ 'od du zhu ba las/ rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can spyan ma dang 'khril sbyor tu bzhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi chu rgyun dkar nar gyis babs pas lus gang*/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su bla ma'i gsung gi sa bon āḥdamar po/ aḥbhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes pas āḥ'od du zhu ba las 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can gos dkar mo dang 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi chu rgyun dmar lhug lhug 'bab pa sogs 'dra/

snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su bla ma'i thugs kyi sa bon hūm̐ sngon po/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes pas hūm̐ 'od du zhu zhugs ba las mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon mnyam bzhag can dbyings phyug ma dang 'khril ba'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi chu rgyun sngo breng gi byung ba sogs 'dra/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su bla ma'i yon tan gyi sa bon hrīḥser po/ a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes pas hrīḥ'od du zhu ba las rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can ma mā kī dang 'khril ba'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kha dog sna tshogs pa 'byung ba sogs 'dra/ lha de dag sku tshon gang la dar gyi chas gos lnga dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad de zhi ba'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis brgyan pa/ pad zla la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// gsum pa rtsa ba ngo sprod kyi khyad par la mnyam rjes gnyis las/ mnyam bzhag la lus kyi gnad chos bdun sngar ltar 'dra/ ngag gi gnad 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung drag tu mnan/ dbugs kyi 'gyu ba bcad/ sems kyi gnad rang bzhin sna tshogs su snang ba la rtsal sbyang ba'i phyir/ phra rags kyi rtog pa sna tshogs la spyan lngas blta bar bya ste/ ded dpon rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'gyu ba'i 'phrang btsan thabs su bcad pas/ rlung sems gnyug ma'i (384)gnas 'od gsal du 'ching bar byed/ spyan lnga'i lta stangs kyi gnad 'di ltar ro// zhes so// de yang rtog pa 'gyu ba tshor mi tshor de la/ rus sbal lta bu'i spyan mig lpags 'byar tsam du btsum nas blta ste/ rlung dang rtog pa'i 'gro 'ong bcad de/ 'chun bdo ba la phaṭa ces shigs kyis bshig pa'i blo bral du khres se bzhag go /rtog pa tshor tsam la mgron bu lta bu'i spyan bag tsam btsum la blta/ tha mal gyi rtog pa rang dgar 'gyur na zla tshes lta bu'i spyan gyis cung zad phye la blta/ rtog pa cung zad rags pa la mkhas pa lta bu'i spyan gyis cung zad dpangs bstod la blta/

nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa gnyen po med par skye ba shin tu rags par 'gyur ba la zla ba nya gang ba'i spyan gyis bar snang la bgrad de blta/ de thams cad 'chun bdo ba la bshig cing rjes blo bral gyi ngang la ma bcos par gsal le/ rjen ne/ khres se/ dwangs se bzhag /de yang ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ mtshan nyid blo bral du gnas pa'i don sngar blo spyod du ngo sprad pa de 'dir goms par byas la/ dwangs ma'i shes pa rgyun mthud cing mnyam rjes bsres nas zung 'jug mngon du gyur par bya'o// rjes thob spyod lam gyi dus thams cad du/ gzugs rnams snang tsam nas bden par ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu/ sgra rnams grags tsam nas bden par ma grub pa brag cha lta bu/ dran rtog rnams rjes med dran stong chu'i lbu ba ltar bskyang bar bya'o// bzhi pa rjes gnang lung gi khyad par bla ma'i thugs dam bskul lugs ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes drod kyi ye shes btsan thabs su skye bar byed pa sgrub pa gnad kyi snying po 'bru bcu pa 'di sngar ltar gsol ba mas gdab dang*/ byin rlabs yas zhu'i tshul gyis bgrang bar bya zhing*/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ dpal ldan bla ma longs sku'i bdag nyid can 'grub par gyur cig /ces brjod do// gsum (385)pa la gnyis las/ bslab bya bo zags stem log gi lam gyi dri ma bsrung lugs ni/ dkar thub pas gzhan don sngas na bo ba'i dri ma yin pas de'i bar du chos mi 'chad/ srung ba dang byin rlabs mi bya'o// bsnyen bskur zos na zags pas rang rdzas gzhan la mi ster/ gzhan gyi rdzas rang gis mi spyod/ bsrung sdom lhod na ltems pas skra sen mi 'breg /khrus mi bya/ gos gdan mi sprug /mal mi spo/ ngag gi smra ba bcad do// chos brgyad dran na log pas tshe 'di'i snyan grags rgyab tu dor bar bya'o// gnyis pa tshar tshad la bzhi las/ ngo bo tshar na sngar blo sbyong du sems ngo bo stong par shes pa'i steng du 'dir rang bzhin gsal ba'i der 'dzin dang bral bas/

dran rtog ci skyes lam du khyer shes pa'o// rtags kyi tshar tshad sngar gyi rgyud lam 'bras bu'i rtags rnams 'dir nyams snang gi yul mngon du 'char ro// yon tan gyi tshar tshad phyi nang gi srog chags kyis mi 'tshe ba sogs so// grangs kyi tshar tshad bye ba phrag lnga dang dus zla ba gsum mo// sbyor lam dka' thub kyi khrid yig go /gsum pa mthong lam spyod pa rjes kyi khrid la gsum ste/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi nyams su blangs tshul/ rjes bslab bya tshar tshad dang bcas pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ rten bskyed pa ni/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang bskyed kyang 'dir bla ma snang stong dbyer med rdo rje'i skur sgrub pa'i skabs yin pas/ bla ma sku gcer bu la rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan zhing sku mdog mthing ga 'ba' zhig tu sgom pa yin no// gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa dang*/ gsum pa lam brten pa sngar dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ dang po grags pa sgra'i brjod tshul yi ge lam khyer ni/ dbyangs gsal lan bzhi brjod pa'i/ dang po gzugs su snang tshad ngo bo rnam pa yi dam gyi lha rigs lnga'i skur (386)gsal ba de yang dang po skye ba med/ bar du gnas pa med/ tha mar 'gags pa med/ bden pa'i dngos por grub pa med de gzugs snang stong du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrar grags tshad ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa yi dam rigs lnga'i gsung sngags kyi rang sgrar grags pa de'ang*/ dang po skye ba med/ bar du gnas pa med/ tha mar 'gags pa med/ bden pa'i dngos por grub pa med de sgra grags stong du shes par bya/ gsum pa sems kyi dran rtog 'gyu tshad ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa yi dam rigs lnga'i thugs ye shes su gsal ba de'ang*/ dang por skye med/ bar du gnas pa med/ tha mar 'gag med/ bden dngos su grub pa med de yid dran stong du shes par bya/ bzhi pa snang grags 'gyu gsum thams cad kyang rang gi sems ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa yi dam rigs lnga'i sku gsum thugs su gnas pa de'ang*/

dang por skye med/ bar du gnas med/ tha mar 'gag med bden dngos su grub pa med de/ sems bde stong gnyis med du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa dbang bzhi dmigs pa'i khyad par 'khor lo bzhi'i sgom thabs ni/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus su bla ma'i rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥganas pa rnams a bhi ṣiñca oṃ sogs sngags bzhis rim par rigs bzhi'i bde bar gshegs pa yab yum gyi skur bzhugs par gsal btab la/ sku bzhi ka'ang skye med gnas med 'gags med dngos med do// zhes brjod pas mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyi rgyas gdab bo// gsum pa rtsa ba ngo sprod kyi khyad par la gnyis las/ mnyam rjes rtsa ba'i lam khyer ni/ ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba/ mtshan nyid gnyis su med par grol bar bya ba'i phyir lta stangs lnga bsgyur bar bya ste/ 'khor ba dang ngan song du 'khyams shing lhung ba'i dog pa gcod pa'i phyir nyan thos zhi ba'i lta stangs thur du/ mtho ris dang thar pa thob 'dod kyi re ba gcod pa'i phyir mu stegs tshangs pa'i lta stangs gyen du/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa gcod pa'i phyir sems dpa'i lta stangs g.yas su/ (387)'dod chags kyi rtog pa gcad pa'i phyir sems ma'i lta stangs g.yon du/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi rtog pa can bsam gtan 'ching ba gcod pa'i phyir bde bar gshegs pa'i lta stangs thad kar bsgyur bar bya ste/ bram ze gser gyi ska rags can gyis/ shes rab kyi gcod thabs lam du khyer bas/ gnyis med lam du slongs par byed/ des na zung 'jug rgyud la skye bar byed pa'i gnad yin/ zhes so// de dag gi dus thams cad du lus ngag gi 'khrul 'khor dang sems sgrim glod kun dka' thub dang mtshungs mod/ 'dir dka' thub kyi rjes la sems kyi gshis rtsa ba'i don ji ltar 'byongs pa de la spyod lam bzhir dran pas bzung nas nyams yengs med du bskyang ba yin no// rjes spyod lam gyi dus thams cad du gzugs su snang tshad yang dag par ma grub ste/

rang bzhin gyis stong zhing*/ de yang gnas skabs rten 'brel gyi snang ba ma 'gags par gzugs su snang la/ snang tsam nyid na ngo bo stong pa nyid las ma g.yos par/ gzugs stong pa las gzhan ma yin zhing*/ ngo bo stong pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin du rtsal gzugs su ma 'gags par snang bas/ stong pa nyid las gzugs gzhan ma yin te/ de lta bu'i mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du 'char bas na/ rnam mkhyen gyi bar chos thams cad la de bzhin du 'gre shes par bya'o// bzhi pa rjes gnang lung gi khyad par bla ma'i thugs dam bskul lugs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥgu ru dzi na mi tra hūm̐/ zhes rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gcig car du 'char bar byed pa rtog pa rjes kyi snying po 'bru bcu pa 'di sngar ltar gsol ba mas gdab dang*/ byin rlabs yas zhu'i tshul gyis bgrang zhing*/ thun gtong ba'i tshe/ dpal ldan bla ma snang stong dbyer med rdo rje'i sku grub par gyur cig /ces brjod do// gsum pa la gnyis las/ bslab bya lam gyi dri ma bsrung lugs ni/ rjes kyi dus 'dir gzhi la g.ya' chags na gshis thog tu bo bas so ma'i mal rjes/ gnyen po'i bya ra ma 'gyel na nyams (388)thog tu zags pas nyams myong gshis thog tu gzhig /rang lta la mchog tu zhen na go thog tu ltems pas yang dag pa'i don la 'di yin du mi bzung*/ grub mtha'i 'dod pa ma zhig na tshig thog tu log pas gang du'ang khas mi blang ngo*// gnyis pa tshar tshad la bzhi las/ ngo bos tshar na gnyis med blo bral rang gi mtshan nyid du rtogs/ rtags kyis tshar na rgyu lam 'bras bu'i rtags rnams 'dir mngon sum du 'char/ yon tan gyi tshar na sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal mthong zhing khams brgya g.yo ba'i nus pa sogs 'byung*/ grangs kyis tshar na bye ba phrag phyed dang gsum/ dus zla ba phyed dang gnyis so// mthong lam rjes kyi khrid yig go /bzhi pa sgom lam spyod pa ro snyoms kyi khrid la gsum ste/

sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi nyams su blang lugs/ rjes bslab bya tshar tshad dang bcas pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ rten bskyed pa ni/ 'dir bla ma bde ba chen po mnyam pa nyid kyi skur sgrub pa'i dus yin pas rten rgyas bsdus gang ltar kyang sku cha lugs la nges pa med pa gang mos su bsgom par bya/ gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa dang*/ gsum pa lam brten pa sngar dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ dang po grags pa sgra'i brjod tshul yi ge lam khyer ni/ dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnams mas nas lugs ldog tu lan bzhir brjod pa'i/ dang po gzugs su snang tshad bla ma yi dam gyi sku dang tha mal gyi lus su snang ba la bzang ngan gyi khyad par cung zad kyang med de snang stong*/ gnyis pa sgrar grags tshad bla ma yi dam gyi gsung dang sems can gyi skad du snang ba la bzang ngan med de grags stong*/ gsum pa dran rtog thams cad bla ma yi dam gyi thugs dang sems can gyi yid du snang bar bzang ngan med de bde stong gnyis med/ bzhi pa de thams cad kyang rang sems skye med la bzang ngan dang go rim (389)spangs blang med de gnyis med du 'dzin pa tsam du'ang mi bya bar thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rgyas gdab bo// gnyis pa dbang bzhi dmigs pa'i khyad par 'khor lo bzhi'i sgom thabs ni/ snying lte mgrin dpral gyi 'khor lo bzhir hūm̐ hrīḥ.āḥ.oṃ sgom pa rnams/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ sogs kyis 'khor lo bzhir bde bar gshegs pa bzhi go rim ma nges par gsal gdab cing*/ dbang yang dag rim ma nges par blang bar bya'o// gsum pa rtsa ba ngo sprod kyi khyad par la gsum las/ rtsa ba don gyi lam khyer du/ sngar gyi mtshan nyid gnyis med blo bral gyi rtogs pa phyin ci ma log pa de spyod lam gyi dus dang bde sdug gi rkyen gang la'ang khyad med du bsre zhing chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du byed pa ste/

bdag nyid chen po ka ma la shrī badz+ra gyi zhal nas/ lam la gang phan grogs su brten pas a 'thas kyi dngos 'dzin 'jig par byed/ gral rim 'gyel brgya yan gyi gnad yin/ zhes bstan to// de yang sngar gyi rten 'brel gyi brda spyan lta stangs lnga po de dag spyod lam bzhi dang bsres nas nyams su len pa ste/ des na rtsa ba'i spyod lam bzhi las yan lag gi spyod lam nyi shur phye la nyams su blang ngo*// de yang 'dug pa'i spyod lam lnga ni/ rten 'brel dag pa rdo rje skyil krung*/ phyed skyil/ tsog pu/ snyes pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs so// nyal ba lnga ni/ g.yas nyal/ g.yon nyal/ gan rkyal/ kha sbubs/ mgo bstum/ brla sgrim mo// langs pa lnga ni/ langs ka /phyed langs/ langs pa/ gos tshags byed pa/ goms pa 'dor ba'o// 'gro ba lnga ni/ 'gro ba/ 'gro 'phro la 'chams pa/ rgyug pa/ rgyug 'phro la 'chams pa/ ngal bso ba'o// sdud pa las/ 'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug par shes bzhin rab tu ldan/ zhes pas/ (390)bye brag gyi spyod lam nyi shu po re re la'ang lta stangs lnga lnga/ de re re la'ang spyan lnga lnga sbyar nas mnyam bzhag gi dus su bltas nas rjes glod pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin lnga brgya phrag gcig tu sgrim gyin glod pa ni zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o// gang ltar sgom yang*/ 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung mnan/ rlung 'gyu ba bcad de/ chun rdo la shigs kyis bshig cing rjes sems gang du'ang ma bcos par lhod de khres se/ rtog med rang dwangs su rjen ne bzhag go /lar spyod lam gyi dus thams cad du rtsa ba'i nyams myong dang ma bral bar bya zhing*/ bde sdug gi rkyen gang la rang rig pa thog rdug med pa cham cham pa yed yed pa/ bun long long ba lam du khyer zhing bskyang bar bya ste/ bram ze ye shes snying po'i zhal nas/ rig pa la seng yer gyis hrig bton pas rno ngar gyi rtsi chags par byed/

bying rmugs kyi gdan 'jig pa'i gnad yin no// zhes so// rjes spyod lam gyi dus thams cad du pha rol tu phyin pa rnam dag chen po'i 'gres rkang dang bstun zhing ma yengs par bskyang ste/ 'di ltar/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pas/ gzugs rnam par dag pa/ gzugs rnam par dag pas/ bdag rnam par dag pa/ de ltar gzugs rnam par dag pa dang*/ bdag rnam par dag pa dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'di la gnyis su med de/ gnyis su byar med de so so ma yin tha mi dad do// zhes pa grags pa'i sgra dang*/ dran pa'i sems la'ang mthun par sbyar ro// bzhi pa rjes gnang lung gi khyad par bla ma'i thugs dam bskul lugs ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru pra ma ṇa ye hūm̐/ zhes ro snyoms chen po'i rtogs pa rgyud la skye bar byed pa'i 'bru bcu pa 'di sngar ltar gsol ba mas gdab dang*/ byin rlabs yas zhu'i tshul du (391)bgrang zhing*/ thun bsdu ba na/ dpal ldan bla ma bde ba chen po mnyam pa nyid kyi sku 'grub par gyur cig /ces brjod do// gsum pa la gnyis las/ bslab bya dri ma bzhi bsrung lugs ni/ ro snyoms pas dus 'dir/ bdag 'dzin gyi kha mthengs na rang thog tu bo bas ngas byas kyi ngo so mi bya/ 'khon 'dzin rgyud la brten na gzhan thog tu zags pas gzhan gyis brnyas pa la ko long mi bya/ gnyis snang gi mtha' ma khrol na go thog tu ltems pas/ bdag gzhan gnyis su mi bzung*/ zags pa'i 'phan langs na 'khrul thog tu log pas chags sdang gi rjes mi bcad do// gnyis pa tshar tshad la bzhi las/ ngo bos tshar na yul la spang blang med cing spyod lam la khyad par med par mtshan nyid blo bral gyi rtogs pa chu bo rgyun gyi rnam thar du 'char ro// rtags kyis tshar na rgyu lam 'bras bu'i rtags rnams sngar las 'phel zhing gsal brtan du 'gyur ro// yon tan gyis tshar na/ sngar mthong lam gyi yon tan las mang por 'phel lo// grangs kyis tshar na 'bum tsho phyed dang bcu gsum/

dus zla ba gcig go /sgom lam ro snyoms kyi khrid yig go /lnga pa mthar lam bya bral gyi khrid la gsum ste/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi nyams su blang lugs/ rjes bslab bya tshar tshad dang bcas pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ rten bskyed pa ni// rgyas bsdus gang ltar bsgoms kyang 'dir bla ma sprul pa'i skur sgrub pa'i dus yin pas mchog gi sprul sku dge slong gi cha byad can no// gnyis pa tshogs bsags dang*/ gsum pa lam brten pa sngar dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ dang po grag pa sgra'i brjod tshul yi ge lam khyer ni/ āk+ṣa lnga bcu po mas nas a yig 'ba' zhig tu lan bzhi brjod pa'i// dang po gzugs su snang tshad rang snang la snang ba (392)med pa nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar thim pa las gzhan snang la sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i skur snang bas phrin las rgyun mi chad par gyur/ gnyis pa sgrar grags tshad rang snang la snang ba med pa nam mkha'= /gzhan snang la sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i gsung du snang bas phrin las rgyun mi chad par gyur/ gsum pa 'gyu byed dran rtog thams cad rang snang la snang ba= gzhan snang la sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i thugs= bzhi pa de thams cad rar sems su thag bcad cing*/ de'ang rang snang la snang ba med par nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa'am/ rgya mtsho la khyags pa zhu ba ltar chos nyid la yang dag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'ang blo bral gyi dbyings su thim pa las gzhan snang la sprul pa'i sku'i ḍā ki ma bzhir snang ba 'gro don la bskul bas phrin las rgyun mi chad par mdzad par bsam mo// gnyis pa dbang bzhi dmigs pa'i khyad par 'khor lo'i bsgom thabs ni/ bo dhi tsit+ta oṃ/ zhes pas bde chen 'khor lo'i rnam snang yab yum du gsal ba'i yab byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu nas yum la thim pas/ yum nyid gzhan don gyi phrin las sgrub phyir sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod khrag bsnams par gyur te gzhan snang zil gyis gnon par gyur/

bo dhi tsit+ta āḥs longs spyod 'khor lo'i 'od dpag med byang sems su zhu nas yum la thim pas yum nyid phrin las sgrub phyir pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo pad+ma dang thod khrag bsnams par gyur te/ gzhan snang bdag gi dbang du sdud/ bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐ gis chos kyi 'khor lo'i mi bskyod pa byang sems su zhu nas yum la thim pas yum nyid phrin las sgrub phyir rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo rdo rje dang thod khrag bsnams par gyur te dbang du 'dus pa'i gdul bya rnams bdag la dad cing 'dun par byas/ bo dhi tsit+ta hrīḥs sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rin 'byung byang sems su (393)zhu nas yum la thim pas yum nyid phrin las bsgrub phyir rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo rin po che dang thod khrag bsnams par gyur te dad par gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams dam pa'i chos kyis rang rang gi bsam pa tshim par byed pa ste/ ḍā ki bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rang rtags nam mkhar 'phyar stabs dang*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs so// gsum pa rtsa ba ngo sprod kyi khyad par la gnyis las/ rtsa ba don gyi lam khyer du/ mnyam rjes gnyis su med par 'dres phyin chad nas/ lta sgom gyi 'dzin pa thams cad bshig la/ kye ma chos thams cad stong pa'i ngo bor yang ma grub par 'dug pas/ da phyin chad sems can gyi don las/ rang don du blta rgyu mi 'dug ste/ mi lta/ blta re shi /bltas na'ang nga la sdig /mi sgom/ sgom re shi /bsgom na'ang nga la sdig /mi spyod/ spyod re shi /spyod na'ang nga la sdig /mi sgrub/ sgrub re shi /bsgrub na'ang nga la sdig /snyam du/ rang don du rang la 'khris pa'i gnyen po bshig nas zhe mna' skyal/ blo thag bcad la gzhan don du ci 'gyur bya ste/ bdag nyid chen po rat+na badz+ra gyi zhal nas/ 'ching ba'i grogs su chos ma btang bas/

des lha bdud du mi 'bab par byed/ des thar lam 'bras bu'i grogs su 'gro ba'i gnad yin/ zhes bstan no// rjes spyod kyi dus su'ang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la byams snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ tha na dud 'gro'i rna bar kaṃ ka ni'i gzungs sgrogs pa dang*/ gzhan skyabs sems dang dbang chog ster ba sogs gang 'tshams kyi sgo nas kun gzhi la thar pa'i sa bon 'jog /da lta dngos su phan ma thogs pa rnams kyang nam zhig bdag gi (394)gdul byar smon lam gdab par bya'o// bzhi pa rjes gnang gi khyad par bla ma'i thugs dam bskul lugs ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru bhu hu ku ru hūm̐/ zhes gzhan don phun tshogs sgrub pa'i las sbyor sgom pa bdag gtod kyi snying po 'bru bcu pa 'di gsol ba mas gdab dang byin rlabs yas zhu'i tshul du bgrang zhing*/ thun bsdu ba na dpal ldan bla ma sprul sku'i bdag nyid can grub par gyur cig /ces brjod do// gsum pa la gnyis las/ bslab bya dri ma bzhi bsrung lugs ni/ bdag gtod bya bral gyi dus 'dir/ 'bras bu'i sgrub blo ma dag na re ba'i thog tu bo bas rang don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod spangs/ 'khor ba spang byar mthong na dgos steng du zags pas 'khor ba ma stongs par 'khor bar gnas nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i go cha bgo /gnyis 'dzin gyi blo ma dag na byas pa'i dge ba la zhen 'khris kyis ltems pas ci byed gzhan don bya/ spyod lam tha mal du shor na chos brgyad du 'chor bas log pa'i dri ma yin pas tshe 'di'i zhen 'khris spangs nas mi tshe sgrub pa la bskyal lo// gnyis pa tshar tshad la bzhi las/ ngo bos tshar na dran pas bzung mi dgos par blo rtog thams cad gnyug ma chos dbyings su thim nas dge sbyor dang 'bral ba med pa 'byung*/ rtags kyis tshar na rgyu lam 'bras bu'i rtags rnams shin tu gsal brtan du 'gyur/ yon tan gyis tshar na sangs rgyas pa'i yon tan gyi chos dngos su thob pa la reg pa'o// grangs kyis tshar na bdun 'bum dang*/

dus zla ba phyed do// mthar lam bdag gtod bya bral gyi khrid yig go /gnyis pa de dka' thub gsum gyi bsrang nas 'don pa la gsum tshan bzhi las/ dang po dpe gsum gyi/ dpe dang po/ dpon la ltos shing sgro 'dogs gcod pa nyan thos lta bu'i dka' thub ni/ mos gus kyi bla ma gnad la bor te (395)phyag bzhes kyi khrid legs par zhus nas shes par byed pa'o// dpe gnyis pa rang gcig pur sgrub pa nyams su len pa rang rgyal lta bu'i dka' thub ni/ dben par dag snang gis yi dam las sde btsugs dngos grub tshe 'dir thob bar byed pa'o// dpe gsum pa rang don mthar phyin nas gzhan don byed pa dpa' chen byang sems kyi dka' thub ni/ phrin las kyi rten 'brel 'grig pa'i gnas rnams su mkha' 'gro las la bkol te gzhan don 'ba' zhig lhur len pa'o// gnyis pa gang zag gsum ni/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba spangs pa rab tu byung ba'i phyogs/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba pang du len pa khyim pa'i phyogs/ spyod lam sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pas yo byad gsog 'jog med pa ldom bu pa'i phyogs so// gsum pa dus gsum ni/ gang zag gsum po re re la'ang ring thung gsum ste/ rab byung la rang rgyal lta bu'i dka' thub kyi bogs rab lo bcu gnyis/ 'bring lo drug /tha ma lo gsum/ khyim par rab zla ba gsum/ 'bring zla ba gnyis/ tha ma zla ba gcig go /ldom bu ba rab zhag gsum/ 'bring zhag gnyis/ tha ma zhag gcig go /bzhi pa bskur lugs gsum ni/ rab byung rkyang pa zhes bya ste/ lam snga ma snga ma mthar ma phyin par phyi ma mi sbyin zhing nyams su len du mi 'jug pas mthar chags kyi lam mthar phyin pa la sbyor ba'o// khyim pa gug pa zhes bya ste/ zla ba gcig sogs ji tsam khoms pa de srid du lam lnga char rdzogs pa dang*/ yang phyis ji tsam khoms pa de la snga ma bskyar te lam mthar phyin par 'jug pa'o// ldom bu ba la sbrags ma zhes bya ste zhag gcig gam thun gcig gi nang du lam lnga char rdzogs par nyams su len du 'jug pa'o// de ltar bskur lugs gsum du phye bas gang zag phyogs gsum char gyis sgrub pa'i dam bca' (396)ma nyams par mthar phyin par 'gyur ba yin te/

drang srong bde ba'i go cha'i zhal nas/ dka' thub kyi srang rim pa gsum du phye bas sgrub pa bo zag la mi 'gro bar/ dri ma ngos 'dzin bsrung sdom gyi gnad zung zhig /ces bstan no// gsum pa bya bral 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de nyid lam gyi rtsol ba dang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis mngon du gyur nas glo bur gyi dri ma rnam par dag pa mthar thug pas dbyings kyi ngang du rig pa'i ye shes grol ba chos kyi sku dang*/ de'i steng nas rang bzhin gsal ba'i rtsal phyogs med du rdzogs shing rig pa la dbang thob pas dag pa'i sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa gdul bya dag pa'i ngor snang ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ de'i steng nas sems kyi mtshan nyid snang stong dbyer med kyi ngang las thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa gang la gang 'dul du snang ba ni/ sprul pa'i sku dang*/ sku gsum po de dag kyang dbyer med du gyur pa ni bde ba chen po'i sku ste/ de ltar sku bzhi brnyes nas ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gdul bya 'dul ba'i phrin las phyogs ris med par khyab/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar de srid du 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba yin no// thob pa'i dus ni rab kyis mthong ba'i chos tshe 'di nyid la/ 'bring gis 'chi kar/ tha mas bar do las mi 'gyangs par thob par 'gyur te/ de yang ngo bos tshar na tshe 'di nyid la/ rtags kyis 'chi khar/ grangs kyis bar dor nges par 'grub/ yon tan gyis skye ba brgyud nas 'byung ba yin zhes 'byung ngo*// de dag gis dngos gzhi lam lnga'i dmar khrid kyi khrid yig thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams dpal gyis mdzad pa la gzhi byas te kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams nag 'gros bklag chog mar bkod pa tshar ro// gsum pa zhar byung thabs kyi yan lag gzhan bshad pa la gsum ste/ gegs bsal ba/ bogs 'don pa/

sgrub pa ji ltar bya ba'i gnad (397)kyi sgo bstan pa'o// dang po la/ 'byung ba cha ma mnyam pa'i gegs sel/ thabs shes kyi 'byams gcod/ lam so so'i dri ma bzhi bsal tshul lo// dang po ni/ sgrub pa po me shas che bas nyams rgod cing tshig pa za na/ zla ba tshes pa lta bu'i spyan gyis sems gzhi thog la glod la/ oṃ u ū pa pha ba bha ma la ha swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs bgrangs pas rig pa rang gnas su chags par 'gyur ro// rlung shas che bas rig pa 'phros nas mi gnas na nya lta bu'i spyan gyis rig pa yul la gtod cing*/ oṃ o ā+o ta tha da dha na la sa swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas rig pa gnas par 'gyur ro// sa shas che bas lci shing 'thibs na/ mkhal ma lta bu'i spyan gyis rig pa ngar bskyed cing sengs te bar snang la gtad nas/ oṃ i ī tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya ya sha swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas nyams dang rig pa rno ngar dang ldan par 'gyur ro// chu shas che bas nyams 'dar zhing 'thibs na zla ba nya gang ba lta bu'i spyan gyis rig pa dpangs bstod de/ oṃ e ai ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ra sha swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas nyams rig pa rno ngar dang ldan par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ shes rab kyi rig pa brtag dpyad la 'byams na/ rus sbal gyi lta stangs kyis rig pa gzhi thog tu glod la/ oṃ dang swā hā'i bar du gsal byed so bzhi bcug nas bzlas pas nyams kyi rtsi dang ldan par 'gyur ro// thabs kyi rig pa nyams la 'byams shing ltems na lta stangs phyogs med du bsgyur zhing*/ ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ bzhi spangs pa'i dbyangs bcu gnyis oṃ dang swā hā'i bar du bcug nas bzlas pas rig rtsal phyogs med du 'char ro// thabs ya bral du gyur na/ lta stangs 'bag gi mig bzhin bskor te/ oṃ ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas zung 'jug gi rtogs pa skye bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa ni/ rang sa'i bo zags ltems log bzhi la rim par/ a kan dhī ma hā kan dhi swā hā/

a kan ta pa ra ni dhi swā hā/ i su ma ba ra ti na la swā hā/ ī na ra si pa ta la swā hā/ (398)zhes dri ma gang byung gi sngags khri phrag re bzlas pas sel zhing*/ rdzas kyi rten 'brel ni/ phyi ba dang grum pa'i sder mo// khyi gu'i mig dang 'khrig ma bzhi dri ma gang byung gi rim pa ltar lus la bcangs pas sel lo// blo sbyong gi dri ma bzhi'i sngags rdzas kyi rten 'brel ni/ u hu ta ma ku lu dzi ma swā hā/ ū me su ra tri pa ti le swā hā/ ṛ pra tsa ri ha ri li ta swā hā/ ṝ do ha bha to la hrī hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bgrang zhing*/ mu tig /gser/ gdung sha rī ram/ bla ma'i thugs dam snying po rnams bcang ngo*// dka' thub kyi dri ma bzhi'i sngags rdzas/ l̥ sho ba ra gu dhe hri ta swā hā/ l̥̄ bha la bhi su ma hri dha ba ra swā hā/ e kun dha li ta na sa ri swā hā/ ai bha ra bha ri hūm̐ dza la swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing*/ spre'u'i srin lag /dbyi'i sen mo/ ba'i nu ma/ bud med/ kye rkang sen rnams lus la bcang ngo*// rjes mthong lam gyi dri ma bzhi'i sngags rdzas/ o ha ku ha na pad sa swā hā/ au ma hā kun dhi ha te la swā hā/ aṃ ma ghu dhe bi shi le re swā hā/ aḥde la ra me na ha da swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing*/ phag pa dang ra'i rna ba/ sha ba dang*/ g.yag rgod kyi rwa rtse lus la bcang ngo// ro snyoms kyi dri ma bzhi'i sngags rdzas/ ka an tsa ma dha la na swā hā/ kha hi saṃ bud+dhi bi sha na swā hā/ ga dharma lu hūm̐ hri pa ra swā hā/ gha ma hā te se ri sa ri swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing*/ phag sna/ gla ba'i mche ba/ rma bya'i mdongs/ kar+sha pa ṇa rnams lus la bcang ngo*// mthar lam gyi dri ma bzhi'i sngags rdzas/ da bi ma ti pra ma ha ri ti swā hā/ tsa to ma ti ku ru dha ni swā hā/ tsha ti la ma ti gha sha ma swā hā/ dza ha ra ha ra pra ga shi swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing*/ spre'u/ khyi'u/ mgar ba/

rkun mo bzhi'i srin lag lus la bcang ngo*// lam re re la'ang sngags rdzas bzhi bzhi yod pa po zags ltem log bzhi las gang byung la sel thabs go rim du sbyar bar bya'o// gnyis pa bogs 'don la/ (399)bla ma la mos gus kyis bskul ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig sgyu rtsal gyi gnang bzhis bogs 'don pa'o// dang po ni/ snying po don gyi lam 'di'i lugs la bla ma'i mos gus kho nas bogs 'don zhing lam gyi yon tan rdzogs par 'dod de/ bla ma'i thugs dam bskul ba/ shin tu bskul ba/ gnad nas bskul ba'i sngags dmigs rnams 'jur por byed pa kho na ste/ de lam lnga ka'i thugs dam bskul ba khrid yig gi dkyus su song bas/ 'dir shin tu dang gnad nas bskul ba gnyis bri bar bya'o// bskul ba gsum po snga ma sā ma la lam rtags ma rdzogs na phyi ma phyi ma la sbyor ba yin no// de la blo sbyong gi shin tu bskul ba ni/ rang gi spyi bor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dkar po'i dbus su bla ma'i sku'i rang bzhin oṃ dkar po dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la sku bskul ba'i sngags oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru sid+dhi hūm̐ zhes pa kha dog dkar pos bskor bar bsam la/ thun dang po la bla ma'i sku bskul ba'i mos pas spyi bo'i sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul du bzla'o// de bzhin thun phyi ma gsum la rim pa ltar/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad/ snying gar dpal be'u rtse brgyad pa kha dog lnga ldan/ lte bar rin po che zur brgyad ser po rnams kyi dbus su rim bzhin gsung gi sa bon āḥdamar/ thugs hūm̐ mthing*/ yon tan phrin las kyi sa bon hrīḥljang ser gsum la rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i blo sbyong gi sngags 'bru brgyad pas bskor bar bsam nas/ gsung dang thugs dang yon tan phrin las bskul ba'i mos pas thun gsum po re re la mgrin snying lte ba'i sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla'o// gnad nas bskul ba ni/

spyi bo'i bla ma'i rtsa 'khor bzhi'i gnas su yang bdag kho na bzhin du sgom la/ thun dang po la bla ma'i sku bskul ba'i mos pas/ rang gi spyi bo'i yig 'bru klog pa'i tshul du bzlas pas yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer (400)dkar po skrag med mi gsal ba'i rnam par rang gi sna bug nas thon/ bla ma'i shangs bug nas zhugs nas spyi bo'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas sku bskul nas/ sku'i byin rlabs yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer shin tu gsal zhing bkrag dang ldan pa bla ma'i shangs bug nas thon pa rang gi sna bug tu zhugs nas spyi bo'i yig 'bru la thim pas bum dbang thob/ lus sgrib sbyangs/ sku'i dngos grub thob nas rang lus rdo rje'i skur gyur par bsam/ de bzhin du thun gnyis pa la gsung gnad nas bskul ba sogs rigs 'gre shes par bya'o// dka' thub kyis shin tu bskul ba ni/ rang dang bla ma'i gnas bzhi'i rtsa 'khor la bla ma'i rdo rje bzhi'i rang bzhin rnam snang sogs rigs bzhi yab yum gyi rnam par bzhugs pa'i yab kyi thugs kar rim bzhin 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ pad 'dab bcu/ dpal be'u rtsa brgyad/ rin chen zur brgyad rnams kyi lte bar sa bon/ mgrin par ma/ gzhan gsum gyi sa bon gyi g.yas g.yon du gu ru dang*/ lhag ma oṃ āḥhrīḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ rnams rtsibs sogs la bkod/ mgrin par gu ru'ang dkyus ltar bkod nas/ thun bzhi la rim bzhin gnas bzhi'i yig 'bru rnams rang dang bla ma'i sngags phreng la re mos kyis klog pa'i tshul du bzlas pas bskul lo// gnad nas bskul ba ni/ rang gi yig 'bru klog pa'i tshul du bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis spyi bo'i bla ma bskul te de las sku'i byin rlabs bsdus pas dbang thob pa sogs blo sbyong ltar sbyar bar bya ste/ gnas bzhir rigs bzhi'i lha bsgom pa'i khyad par tsam mo// rjes kyi shin tu bskul ba ni rang dang bla ma'i gnas bzhir bla ma rigs bzhi'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i thugs kar 'khor lo sogs la yig 'bru bkod pa dka' thub dang 'dra ba las/

khyad par de la skye med sogs kyi rgyas 'debs/ de nas thun bzhir res klog gi tshul kyang 'dra'o// gnad nas bskul ba dang*/ de las 'od zer spro bsdus thun bzhir dbang thob pa (401)sogs sngar dang 'dra'o// ro snyoms kyi shin tu bskul ba ni// rang dang bla ma'i gnas bzhir bla ma rigs bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i thugs kar 'khor lo sogs la yig 'bru rnams dka' thub ltar las/ 'dir go rim nges med du gsal 'debs shing*/ thun bzhi'ang nges med du klog pa'i tshul du bskul lo// gnad nas bskul ba'ang*/ de las 'od zer spro bsdus bskul zhing byin rlabs bsdu ba'ang gzhan 'dra ba las 'dir go rim nges med du byed pa tsam khyad par ro// bya bral gyi shin tu bskul ba ni/ rang dang bla ma'i gnas bzhir mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bzhugs pa'i thugs kar 'khor lo sogs la yig 'bru sngar ltar bsgom la/ thun bzhir res klog gi tshul gyis bskul lo// gnad nas bskul ba ni sngar ltar 'od zer spro bsdus thun bzhir gnad nas bskul ba'o// de ltar thugs dam bskul ba kho nas lam rtags rdzogs na des chog mod/ ma rdzogs na bskul ba phyi ma gnyis rtags dang sbyar te bzlas pas rtags dang yon tan mi rdzogs mi srid do zhes gsung ngo*// thugs dam bskul ba gsum yong ba'i rgyu mtshan yang mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lhag pa'i bsam pa la zhugs nas/ myur du bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pas thog mar bla ma brten par bya/ mnyes par bya/ bsnyen bkur bar bya'o// zhes gsung ba'i don du bzhed do// gal te bskul ba gsum la 'bad kyang des 'ga' zhig lam rtags mi rdzogs pa srid na/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ tshogs bsags pa la sgom gtad med du skye/ zhes gsungs pas thugs dam bskul ba'i gnad bla ma mchod pa gang 'grub phul/ des mnyes nas byin rlabs kyis rtogs pa 'char/

shin tu bskul ba'i gnad 'bul rgyu'i rdzas bla ma la mkho mnyes 'dra'am rang la mkho ba de phul ba'i stobs kyis rtogs pa 'char/ gnad nas (402)bskul ba'i thabs rang la mkho spyad ci 'dra'ang bla ma gang mnyes kyi rdzas ltos pa med par phul bas de'i stobs kyis rtogs pa skye ba yin no// gnyis pa sgyu rtsal gyi gnad bzhi bogs 'don pa la bzhi las/ dang po ngag tu ci smras gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod du 'gro ba'i gnad ni/ 'khor lo 'grib mtshams zhes dgong zhog lag ris mthong mi mthong gi mtshams te/ de yang snga dro dang po bya rog gi skad ma sgrag cing smra ba gzhan ma labs pa'i gong du/ oṃ gyis mgo drangs pa'i ā li bcu drug tshar gsum 'don/ dgong byi'u'i skad chag nas nyal dus swā hās mtha' brten pa'i kā li so bzhi tshar gsum 'don/ de nyin zhag phrug cig la ngag ci smras sngags su gyur nas ci bsgrub kyang nus pa thogs med du 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa lus tha mal du sdad pas rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs su 'gro ba'i gnad ni/ mtshan mo gnyid log dus gzhog g.yas phab la/ kā li tshar gsum brjod pas 'gyu byed kyi rtog pa thams cad sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal dang*/ sems skye med nam mkha' lta bur rgyas btab nas nyal lo// nang par gnyid sad pa'i tshe ā li tshar gsum brjod pas phyi yul snang thams cad rang sems kyi 'char sgor ma 'gags par snang ba sgyu ma lta bur rgyas btab bo// des ni lus ngag tha mal du bsdad kyang tshogs gnyis ma rtsal bar ngang gis rdzogs par 'gyur ro// gsum pa nyon mongs pa can gyi yid la ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal rang rdzogs su 'gro ba'i gnad ni/ nyon mongs pa sems kyi rang rtsal yin pas spangs kyang mi spongs te/ thabs khyad par can gyis lam du byed pa'o// de yang rnal 'byor pa la 'dod chags kyi rtog pa shar na/ 'dod chags rang gi ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas pas rtsa bral du song*/

de'i ngang du oṃ pa pha ba bha ma a ā i ī u ū e ai o au aṃ āḥswā hā/ zhes brgya'am nyer gcig bzlas pas nyon mongs pa de nyid rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings su thim pas 'dod chags sor rtogs ye shes su 'char ro// de bzhin du sbyar te zhe sdang skyes na sngar ltar ngos bzung ste/ ṭa sde dang dbyangs bcu gnyis bzlas pas me long lta bu'i ye shes su 'char ro// (403)phrag dog skyes na ngos bzung la tsa sde dang dbyangs bcu gnyis bzlas pas bya grub ye shes su 'char ro// nga rgyal gyis khengs na ngos bzung nas/ ka sde dbyangs bcu gnyis brjod pas mnyam nyid ye shes su 'char ro// gti mug gis rmongs na ngos bzung la ta sde dang dbyangs bcu gnyis bzlas pas chos dbyings ye shes su 'char ro// de yang lam gyi cha rkyen yul gyi byed pas yul gang dang gang la nyon mongs pa skyes pa de ka la dpangs po bcol nas nyams su len pa ste/ nyon mongs pa gang skyes la cher gyis bltas pas kho rang rang tshugs ma thub par rtsa bral du grol/ de'i ngang bskyang zhing brtan byed du sngags so so bzla ba yin no// brda rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang khrid yig rnying par de tsam las mi 'byung mod/ 'on kyang lus gnad lta stangs bsgyur lugs bla mas mdzad pa mthong ba la/ lus gnad spyir rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung dang lus drang por bsrang nas/ bye brag tu zhe sdang la lag gnyis sor bsnol brkyang bas pus mo g.yon la 'khyud cing lta stangs g.yas su gcun/ 'dod chags la de las ldog ste lag gnyis pus mo g.yas la 'khyud cing lta stangs g.yon du gcun/ gti mug la lag gnyis mthe bos srin lag bsdams pa'i mnyam bzhag dang lta stangs sna rtser phab/ phrag dog la lag gnyis gru mo cung zad brgyangs pa'i thal mo phyed bsnol pang du bzhag cing lta stangs mdun du thad kar gcun/ nga rgyal la lag gnyis sa gnon dang mig gyen du gcun par mdzad do// bzhi pa steng 'og gi sgo la ma brten par rtsa rlung las su rung ba'i gnad ni/

dge sbyor gang byed kyang thun mgor rang gi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis kyi dbus su bla ma'i sku'i sa bon oṃ dang 'dab ma la gsal byed sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su gsung gi sa bon āḥdang rtsa 'dab la dbyangs yig bcu drug /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su thugs kyi sa bon hūm̐ dang 'dab mar a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha brgyad/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa (404)'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus su hrīḥdang 'dab ma la gsal byed sum cu so gnyis tshar gnyis g.yas bskor g.yon bskor du gsal btab/ de yang rtsa dpa' mo la yig 'bru dpa' bo'i tshul lo// de ltar thun mgor yi ge rnams lan re brjod cing yes rim gyis gsal btab nas thun la 'jug /thun thon pa dang yig 'bru rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pas/ yi ge rnams thig le byang chub kyi sems su rim par zhu nas dhū ti'i nang du zhugs te thim pas chos thams cad khams dngas ma byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin spros bral nam mkha' lta bur rjen sangs kyis song bar bsam la ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag go /de yang thabs yig 'bru/ rtsa shes rab/ yig 'bru dhū tir 'bab pas khams kyi dngas ma zhu nas bde ba chen por 'bar ba zung 'jug /des phyi nang gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams mnyes nas rtsa rlung las su rung bar 'gyur bas rang gzhan gyi don kun 'grub par gsungs so// gsum pa sgrub pa ji ltar bya ba'i gnad kyi sgo bstan pa ni/ brda rgyud las/ gcig la gcig dang gcig gsum gcig la gcig /ces gsungs pa'i gcig la gcig ni blo sbyong gi dus te/ rang gi chig rkya mi thub bar du bla ma'i drung du 'dug nas rtag tu dus chos 'phags brten pa ltar/ lus longs spyod kyis bla ma ci mnyes sgrub cing blo sbyong gi bsnyen pa byed pa'o// gcig gsum ni/

dka' thub rjes ro snyoms gsum mo// de yang blo sbyong mthar phyin pa des blo sbyong gi dbang nos nas/ nam zla drod phebs pa'i dus su rtsa rlung gnad du phebs pas/ de dus bla mas gnas dben par khrid de/ tshogs kyi 'khor los mkha' 'gro mnyes par byas nas/ slob bu'i lus po rang gi chus bkrus te/ til mar dang 'bru mar gyis bku mnye byas la rtsa rlung gnyen ldabs kyis gtang*/ de nas gnas yangs par bla mas lta stangs bco lnga bslab cing drod tshad blta/ rtsa ba zin cing lta stangs 'byongs (405)nas bla ma la gtong rag phul te dka' thub la zhugs pas chog gsungs/ de la thog mar gang du sgrub pa'i gnas dben par/ yar ngo'i gza' skar dge ba la rten 'brel khang pa'i nang gi zheng la 'dom gang dang dkyus la 'dom phyed yod pa brtsigs la rtsig pa'i gseb tu rin po che 'bru sman dar sna sogs bkra shis pa'i rdzas ci 'byor gzhug /shar phyogs la sgo bstan/ phyogs gzhan gsum la'ang nang du sgo'i dbyibs sam ri mo lta bu dang phyir dkar khung chung ngu re bton/ nang zhal gyi 'thims pa la sman sna tshogs bsre ba'am chag chag 'debs shing thog legs par phub/ de'i nang steng du rgyal ba yum gyi bla re phub/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo'i dkyil 'khor bri/ sgo bzhi la e waṃ ma ya/ gru chad bzhi la mam kha la lbo/ log la bu mo gtsang ma'i so sen la bris pa'i āk+ṣaḥrnams dgram/ 'phang lo phyogs bzhir gdags/ sgo rgyab bzhir rgya mdud kyi ri mo yang bya/ de la rab gnas ni/ sngar rang gi khang 'jug thob pa'i bla ma bzhugs na spyan drangs la rab gnas zhu/ ma bzhugs pa'am sa thag ring bas spyan ma 'drongs na/ sngar khang 'jug byas pa'i me tog yod na gtor bas khyab/ med na dge slong bzhi la bshos drangs nas rab gnas zhu ba'am/ yang na rang gi bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab nas/ 'bru la rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa gtor zhing*/ mjug tu/

rab tu gnas par gyur cig /bkra shis par gyur cig /ces brjod pas rab gnas su 'gro ba yin no// de ltar khang pa dngos grub na legs/ ma grub na'ang khang 'jug gi dbang thob phyin khang pa rung mthun la de yin par mos nas sngar ltar me tog gtor nas rab gnas byas pas chog gsungs/ der zhugs nas sgrub pa byed pa la/ lam lnga stan gcig tu byed na der zad/ de min dka' thub rjes ro snyoms gsum bya ste/ de la thog mar cha rkyen gsum bsags pa ni/ 'tsho ba'i rkyen khams dang mthun pa'i sman dang kha zas (406)bldab thang du bsog /grogs kyi rkyen g.yog yid du 'ong ba brten/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi cha rkyen dka' thub kyi grogs su 'gro ba brten no// rgyu gsum spangs te/ rdzas kyi rten 'brel nyams pa'i rgyu rang gi zas gos mi la mi sbyin zhing mi'i zas gos rang mi brten/ lus kyi rten 'brel nyams pa'i rgyu skra sen mi 'breg /gzhan la byin rlabs mi bya/ mchil snabs mi 'dor/ khrus mi bya/ gos stan mi sprug go /ngag gi rten 'brel nyams pa'i rgyu chos mi 'chad/ sngags mi rgyags/ nyams rtogs mi smra/ rtags mtshan mi bshad do// byin rlabs gsum bya ste/ lus tha mal gyi rtog pa spangs te lhar brlab/ ngag smra ba bcad la sngags bgrang*/ sems lta stangs kyis gcun nas rtog pa snga phyi'i rgyun mi mthud do// sbyor ba gsum mngon du gtong ba ni/ gnas kyi sbyor ba phyags brdar dang maṇ+ḍal rkyang nul bya/ rten gyi sbyor ba bla ma dkon mchog gi rten dgram/ gtor ma gta' gtor che ba zhig gta' mar bzung la chos skyong la khas blang*/ rgyun gtor ci 'byor gtong la gtor ma phyir mi dbye bar snod du bsags/ 'jug dus gdon bgegs la brngan byin la bka' bsgo zhing bskrad/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngos la gnas po bcol nas rogs dan zhu/ brda' rgyud las/ tshad spos rma bya'i phru gu smin mi byed/

ces pas ro snyoms ma thems kyi bar sgrub gnas mi spo/ sgrub pa'i dam bca' yun thung du blangs te bar ma chad par yun bsring nas sgrub pas bar gcod mi 'byung zhing dngos grub thob pa'i dgos pa yod/ sngar gyi bsrung bya phal cher dka' thub bar pa rang rgyal gyi dus 'dir bsrung zhing khyad par sbyor lam gyi dus su shin tu dam par bsrung dgos so// gang ltar yang*/ tshe 'di ltos kyi 'dod pa'i bdag 'dzin gyi blo'i zhen 'khris rbad bcad nas rten sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing rnal 'byor gyi rang sa drug ma nyams pa'i sgo (407)nas sgrub pa po zags ltems log gi dri mas ma gos par sgrub cing*/ gos na rang rang gi bsal thabs sogs lam gyi gegs sel bogs 'don rnams sngar bshad pa ltar skabs babs su sbyar nas lam gyi tshar tshad mthar ma phyin gyi bar du sa sde btsugs la bsgrub par bya'o// de nas gcig la gcig ni dpa' chen gyi dus bdag gtod kyi sgrub pa mthar phyin nas gzhan don la 'jug pa'o// yang rten 'brel mi 'char zhing sgrub pa po zags su song ba dang*/ dri mas thems pa la sogs pa'i dus su rang khrus byas nas rten 'brel khang par zhugs la/ dkon mchog la mchod pa phul/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ de nas thun la zhugs nas lam lnga lam gsum gang byed kyang*/ lam lnga gso ba'i sngags dang rten 'brel 'char byed kyi sngags ci rigs pa dang*/ skabs skabs su rten 'brel snying po dang*/ mu ne'i snying po yang bzla zhing*/ de'i dus su ston pa'i sku'am mu ne'i sngags rtsig 'debs la 'bri bar bshad la/ khang pa'i nang du mi gzhan mi gtong ngo*// zhi byed kyi khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu las bka' babs phyi ma lam lnga'i khrid yig 'phros don dang bcas pa bshad pa'i le tshan no// zhes zhi byed bka' babs gsum gyi khrid rgyun gang bzhugs phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas bklags chog tu bkod pa'i khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba 'di yang gnyos kyi dge slong rmongs pa dharma shrīs nyis bris spangs te o rgyan smin grol gling gi chos grwar zin thun du spel ba'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa bla na med pa'i rgyur gyur cig
/dar rgyas 'phel//(408)
